title_en: Identifying Latent Concepts and Structures for Generalized Category Discovery
title_zh: 为广义类别发现识别潜在概念与结构

sentences.en: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to recognize known classes while autonomously discovering novel ones in open-world settings.
sentences.zh: 广义类别发现（GCD）旨在开放世界设置中，在识别已知类别的同时自主发现新颖类别。

sentences.en: However, current approaches primarily focus on designing clustering objectives, often overlooking a critical bottleneck: standard vision backbones yield high-rank, entangled token representations that are ill-suited for unsupervised discovery of latent concepts and structures.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前方法主要聚焦于设计聚类目标，往往忽视了一个关键瓶颈：标准视觉骨干产生高秩、纠缠的词元表示，它们不适于无监督地发现潜在概念与结构。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Compositional Primitive Fields (CPF-GCD), a novel representation learning framework that reshapes the feature space to make such latent structure identifiable by enforcing a low-rank compositional organization.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了组合基元场（CPF-GCD），一个新颖的表示学习框架，它通过强制一种低秩的组合组织来重塑特征空间，使此类潜在结构可识别。

sentences.en: Our core hypothesis is that all categories, whether known or novel, can be expressed as compositions and spatial arrangements of a finite set of learnable visual primitives that capture reusable concepts.
sentences.zh: 我们的核心假说是：所有类别，无论是已知还是新颖的，都可以表示为有限的可学习视觉基元（它们捕获可复用的概念）的组合与空间排列。

sentences.en: CPF instantiates this geometric constraint via a spatial field mechanism.
sentences.zh: CPF通过一种空间场机制实例化这一几何约束。

sentences.en: Inserted between the backbone and the head, it rewrites noisy patch tokens through low-rank primitive mixtures, effectively decomposing images into reusable atomic parts and their spatial layouts.
sentences.zh: 它被插入骨干与头部之间，通过低秩基元混合重写带噪的patch词元，有效地将图像分解为可复用的原子部件及其空间布局。

sentences.en: By explicitly modeling the spatial distribution of primitives, CPF enables novel categories to emerge naturally as new activation patterns over a shared vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 通过显式建模基元的空间分布，CPF使新颖类别能够作为共享词汇表上的新激活模式自然涌现。

sentences.en: This shifts the focus of representation from merely partitioning global embeddings to constructing a structured and separable primitive field.
sentences.zh: 这使表示的关注点从单纯划分全局嵌入转变为构建一个有结构、可分离的基元场。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CPF serves as a generic, plug-and-play module that consistently boosts performance across diverse GCD baselines, validating that identifying and leveraging low-rank compositional structure is a crucial inductive bias for open-world recognition.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，CPF充当一个通用、即插即用的模块，在多样化GCD基线上持续提升性能，验证了识别并利用低秩组合结构是开放世界识别的一个关键归纳偏置。

title_en: Identifying Learnwares via Reduced Neural Conditional Mean Embedding
title_zh: 通过约简神经条件均值嵌入识别可复用模型（Learnwares）

sentences.en: The learnware paradigm aims to establish a market of learnwares, each of which is a well-trained model combined with a specification that describes its functionality without leaking data privacy.
sentences.zh: 可复用模型（Learnware）范式旨在建立一个可复用模型市场，每个模型都是一个训练良好的模型，并附有描述其功能而不泄露数据隐私的规约。

sentences.en: The market enables users to efficiently reuse relevant models based on specifications on their own tasks instead of training models from scratch.
sentences.zh: 该市场使用户能够基于规约在自己的任务上高效复用相关模型，而非从头训练模型。

sentences.en: Recent works have attempted to generate specifications using Reduced Kernel Mean Embedding (RKME), which maps input distributions into Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS) while ignoring the output space, causing models trained on similar input spaces to yield similar specifications, even when their functionalities differ.
sentences.zh: 近期工作尝试使用约简核均值嵌入（RKME）生成规约，它将输入分布映射到再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS），却忽略了输出空间，导致在相似输入空间上训练的模型即使功能不同也会生成相似的规约。

sentences.en: Many labeled-RKME improvements attempt to address this by indirectly modeling the input-output conditional distributions, but they remain limited to classification tasks and lack clear theoretical explanations.
sentences.zh: 许多有标注的RKME改进尝试通过间接对输入-输出条件分布建模来解决这一点，但它们仍局限于分类任务，且缺乏清晰的理论解释。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Reduced Neural Conditional Mean Embedding (RNCME), a novel specification generation method that directly models input-output conditional distributions via Conditional Mean Embedding (CME).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了约简神经条件均值嵌入（RNCME），一种新颖的规约生成方法，它通过条件均值嵌入（CME）直接对输入-输出条件分布建模。

sentences.en: Our RNCME method has a clear theoretical understanding based on CME and is applicable to both regression and classification tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们的RNCME方法基于CME具有清晰的理论理解，且适用于回归和分类任务。

sentences.en: Empirical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our RNCME method.
sentences.zh: 实证实验证明了我们的RNCME方法的有效性和效率。

title_en: Identifying Partially Observed Causal Models from Heterogeneous/Nonstationary Data
title_zh: 从异质/非平稳数据中识别部分观测的因果模型

sentences.en: Estimating causal structure in the presence of latent variables is an important yet challenging problem.
sentences.zh: 在存在潜在变量的情况下估计因果结构是一个重要而富有挑战性的问题。

sentences.en: Recent works have shown that distributional constraints, such as rank deficiency constraints of the covariance matrices, can be exploited to recover the underlying causal structure involving latent variables.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，分布约束（如协方差矩阵的秩亏约束）可以被利用来恢复涉及潜在变量的底层因果结构。

sentences.en: However, real-world data often exhibit heterogeneity/nonstationarity, which pose challenges to existing methods.
sentences.zh: 然而，真实世界数据往往表现出异质性/非平稳性，这对现有方法构成了挑战。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop a principled approach for identifying the structure of partially observed linear causal models from heterogenous/nonstationary data.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们开发了一种有原则的方法，从异质/非平稳数据中识别部分观测的线性因果模型的结构。

sentences.en: We first formulate a class of heterogenous/nonstationary, partially observed linear causal models and prove that their distributional constraints are equivalent to those in the homogeneous case.
sentences.zh: 我们首先表述了一类异质/非平稳、部分观测的线性因果模型，并证明其分布约束与同质情形下的约束等价。

sentences.en: Building on this, we propose a novel rank deficiency test that can efficiently handle heterogenous/nonstationary data, and further establish identifiability results for recovering the causal structure involving latent variables.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们提出了一种新颖的秩亏检验，能够高效处理异质/非平稳数据，并进一步为恢复涉及潜在变量的因果结构建立了可识别性结果。

sentences.en: We also provide a method to identify which variables exhibit distribution shifts, i.e., whose causal mechanisms vary across domains.
sentences.zh: 我们还提供了一种方法，用于识别哪些变量表现出分布漂移，即哪些变量的因果机制跨域变化。

sentences.en: Experiments on simulated and real-world data validate our theoretical findings and the effectiveness of our method.
sentences.zh: 在模拟和真实数据上的实验验证了我们的理论发现和方法有效性。

title_en: IdEst: Assessing Self-Supervised Learning Representations via Intrinsic Dimension
title_zh: IdEst：通过内在维度评估自监督学习表示

sentences.en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for  learning meaningful representations from unlabeled data.
sentences.zh: 自监督学习（SSL）已涌现为从无标注数据中学习有意义表示的一个强大范式。

sentences.en: However, the standard protocol for evaluating these representations,  linear probing, is computationally expensive,  sensitive to hyperparameters, and provides limited insight into the geometric structure of the representation space.
sentences.zh: 然而，评估这些表示的标准协议——线性探针——计算成本高、对超参数敏感，且对表示空间的几何结构提供的洞见有限。

sentences.en: In this work, motivated by connections between neural network generalization  and intrinsic dimension (ID) we propose IdEst,  a method for estimating the ID of SSL representations  via the Minimum Spanning Tree dimension estimator ($\mathrm{dim}_\mathrm{MST}$).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，受神经网络泛化与内在维度（ID）之间联系的启发，我们提出了IdEst，一种通过最小生成树维度估计器（$\mathrm{dim}_\mathrm{MST}$）估计SSL表示ID的方法。

sentences.en: Across diverse datasets, architectures, and SSL pretraining objectives,  we show that IdEst strongly correlates with downstream linear probe performances.
sentences.zh: 跨越多样数据集、架构和SSL预训练目标，我们表明IdEst与下游线性探针性能强相关。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we demonstrate that IdEst enables efficient hyperparameter selection,  significantly reducing the computational cost compared to supervised alternatives.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明IdEst能够实现高效的超参数选择，与有监督替代方案相比显著降低了计算成本。

sentences.en: Our results highlight intrinsic dimensionality  as a principled geometric proxy for assessing SSL representations,  complementing standard supervised probing protocols.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果凸显了内在维度作为评估SSL表示的一个有原则的几何代理，补充了标准的有监督探针协议。

title_en: IDLM: Inverse-distilled Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: IDLM：逆蒸馏扩散语言模型

sentences.en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently achieved strong results in text generation.
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）近期在文本生成方面取得了强劲的效果。

sentences.en: However, their multi-step sampling leads to slow inference, limiting practical use.
sentences.zh: 然而，其多步采样导致推断缓慢，限制了实际用途。

sentences.en: To address this, we extend Inverse Distillation, a technique originally developed to accelerate continuous diffusion models, to the discrete setting.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们将逆蒸馏——一种最初为加速连续扩散模型而开发的技术——扩展到离散设置。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, this extension introduces both theoretical and practical challenges.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种扩展引入了理论和实践两方面的挑战。

sentences.en: From a theoretical perspective, the inverse distillation objective lacks uniqueness guarantees, which may lead to suboptimal solutions.
sentences.zh: 从理论角度看，逆蒸馏目标缺乏唯一性保证，可能导致次优解。

sentences.en: From a practical standpoint, backpropagation in the discrete space is non-trivial and often unstable.
sentences.zh: 从实践角度看，离散空间中的反向传播并非易事，且往往不稳定。

sentences.en: To overcome these challenges, we first provide a theoretical result demonstrating that our inverse formulation admits a unique solution, thereby ensuring valid optimization.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些挑战，我们首先提供了一个理论结果，证明我们的逆公式存在唯一解，从而确保有效的优化。

sentences.en: We then introduce gradient-stable relaxations to support effective training.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们引入了梯度稳定的松弛，以支持有效的训练。

sentences.en: As a result, experiments on multiple DLMs show that our method, *Inverse-distilled Diffusion Language Models (IDLM)*, reduces the number of inference steps by $4 \times$-$64 \times$, while preserving the teacher model’s generation quality.
sentences.zh: 结果是，在多个DLM上的实验表明，我们的方法*Inverse-distilled Diffusion Language Models（IDLM）*将推断步数减少了$4 \times$-$64 \times$，同时保持了教师模型的生成质量。

sentences.en: We provide the code, model checkpoints, and video tutorials on the project page: [https://david-cripto.com/idlm](https://david-cripto.github.io/idlm-project-page)
sentences.zh: 我们在项目页面上提供了代码、模型检查点和视频教程：[https://david-cripto.com/idlm](https://david-cripto.github.io/idlm-project-page)

title_en: IDRBench: Understanding the Capability of Large Language Models on Interdisciplinary Research
title_zh: IDRBench：理解大语言模型在跨学科研究上的能力

sentences.en: Innovation is a key driving force of human civilization.
sentences.zh: 创新是人类文明的关键驱动力。

sentences.en: As the body of knowledge has grown considerably, bridging knowledge across different disciplines, where significant innovation often emerges, has become increasingly challenging.
sentences.zh: 随着知识体系显著增长，跨越不同学科（重大创新往往在此涌现）进行知识联通已变得越来越具有挑战性。

sentences.en: The recent advancements in machine learning models, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), have provided effective access to extensive knowledge sources and shown impressive abilities in reasoning, rendering significant opportunities for interdisciplinary discovery.
sentences.zh: 机器学习模型（尤其是大语言模型（LLM））的近期进展为获取广泛知识源提供了有效途径，并在推理方面展现出令人印象深刻的能力，为跨学科发现创造了重要机遇。

sentences.en: Our research aims to understand the capabilities of state-of-the-art LLMs in integrating knowledge from different fields for interdisciplinary research (IDR).
sentences.zh: 我们的研究旨在理解最先进LLM整合来自不同领域的知识以进行跨学科研究（IDR）的能力。

sentences.en: To address this fundamental problem, we introduce IDRBench, a pioneering framework that includes both datasets and evaluation tasks: (1) IDR Paper Identification, (2) IDR Idea Integration, and (3) IDR Idea Recommendation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一根本问题，我们引入了IDRBench，一个开创性的框架，既包含数据集也包含评估任务：（1）IDR论文识别，（2）IDR想法整合，以及（3）IDR想法推荐。

sentences.en: Our study on ten mainstream LLMs provides a comprehensive analysis of their behavior and establishes benchmarks and baselines for future research.
sentences.zh: 我们对十个主流LLM的研究提供了对其行为的全面分析，并为未来研究建立了基准和基线。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, IDRBench is the first to provide a comprehensive investigation of LLMs' IDR capability.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，IDRBench是首个对LLM的IDR能力进行全面调查的工作。

title_en: IEC: When Information-Driven Exploration Meets Spectral Consensus via Primal–Dual Reward Regularization in Decentralized Multi-Agent RL
title_zh: IEC：去中心化多智能体RL中信息驱动探索遇上通过原始-对偶奖励正则化的谱共识

sentences.en: Decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning  faces a persistent exploration–coordination tension: intrinsic rewards promote exploration under sparse feedback, yet effective cooperation requires agents’ behaviors to remain consistent over a limited communication graph.
sentences.zh: 去中心化多智能体强化学习面临一个持续的探索-协作张力：内在奖励在稀疏反馈下促进探索，而有效的合作要求智能体的行为在有限通信图上保持一致。

sentences.en: Existing methods often combine exploration bonuses and coordination regularizers with fixed-weight schedules, making them hard to tune and prone to either fragmented conventions or premature behavioral collapse.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常以固定权重调度结合探索奖励和协调正则化器，这使得它们难以调优，且容易陷入碎片化约定或过早的行为坍缩。

sentences.en: We propose the IEC (Isomorphic Exploration-Consensus) framework that couples exploration and coordination through a single constrained objective: maximize task return augmented with two complementary exploration signals, dynamics-based information gain and state-coverage novelty, while constraining graph-induced policy disagreement via a spectral smoothness penalty on neighboring agents, which can be interpreted as a Dirichlet-energy regularizer on the communication graph.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了IEC（同构探索-共识）框架，它通过一个受约束的目标耦合探索与协调：最大化由两个互补探索信号（基于动力学的信息增益和状态覆盖新颖性）增强的任务回报，同时通过相邻智能体上的谱平滑惩罚约束图诱导的策略分歧，这可被解释为通信图上的Dirichlet能量正则化器。

sentences.en: IEC optimizes the resulting Lagrangian with a lightweight primal–dual update that adapts the consensus multiplier from observed constraint violations, yielding an automatic shift from diverse exploration to stable cooperative conventions.
sentences.zh: IEC用一种轻量级原始-对偶更新优化所得Lagrangian，该更新根据观测到的约束违例调整共识乘子，从而实现了从多样化探索到稳定协作约定的自动转变。

sentences.en: Across three distinct benchmarks, IEC achieves superior performance.
sentences.zh: 在三个不同的基准中，IEC取得了卓越性能。

title_en: iGRPO: Fast Online RL for Flow Matching Model with Instant Reward
title_zh: iGRPO：带即时奖励的流匹配模型快速在线RL

sentences.en: Conventional practice assumes that online reinforcement learning for flow-matching models requires sampling full denoising trajectories to compute rewards.
sentences.zh: 常规实践假设流匹配模型的在线强化学习需要采样完整的去噪轨迹以计算奖励。

sentences.en: This assumption underlies methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), where the policy must traverse the entire reverse process before receiving a delayed, trajectory-level reward.
sentences.zh: 这一假设支撑着诸如分组相对策略优化（GRPO）等方法，其中策略必须遍历整个逆过程才能接收到一个延迟的、轨迹级的奖励。

sentences.en: We observe, however, that while such terminal rewards provide feedback, they are neither necessary nor optimal for effective learning.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们观察到，虽然此类终端奖励提供反馈，但它们对于有效学习既非必要也非最优。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce iGRPO (Instant-reward GRPO), which replaces GRPO's full-trajectory rollouts with a single-step mapping that assigns rewards instantly at each denoising step.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了iGRPO（即时奖励GRPO），它用单步映射取代GRPO的全轨迹展开，在每个去噪步骤即时分配奖励。

sentences.en: Because the flow matching model behaves differently across timesteps, our step-local instant rewards which are inherently time-dependent, overcome prior approaches that rely on a single, time-independent terminal reward.
sentences.zh: 由于流匹配模型在不同时间步表现不同，我们固有的时间相关的步局部即时奖励，克服了先前依赖单一、时间无关终端奖励的方法。

sentences.en: By evaluating each action locally rather than relying on a final terminal score, iGRPO eliminates the need for multi-step SDE rollouts and offers more precise credit assignment.
sentences.zh: 通过局部评估每个动作而非依赖最终终端分数，iGRPO消除了对多步SDE展开的需求，并提供了更精确的信用分配。

sentences.en: Across standard benchmarks, iGRPO converges 10.2× faster than FlowGRPO while achieving higher final alignment quality.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上，iGRPO的收敛速度比FlowGRPO快10.2倍，同时实现了更高的最终对齐质量。

sentences.en: We hope this work motivates more efficient and scalable online RL methods for flow-matching generative models.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这项工作能推动用于流匹配生成模型的高效可扩展在线RL方法的发展。

title_en: iLoRA: Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation with Latent Interaction Graphs for Microbiome Diagnosis
title_zh: iLoRA：带潜在交互图用于微生物组诊断的贝叶斯低秩适配

sentences.en: Parameter-efficient adaptation has made LLMs practical for domain prediction, but standard LoRA still relies on a static low-rank update and does not expose the latent interactions that often drive scientific labels.
sentences.zh: 参数高效适配已使LLM对领域预测变得实用，但标准LoRA仍依赖静态低秩更新，且不暴露往往驱动科学标签的潜在交互。

sentences.en: We introduce iLoRA.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了iLoRA。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, it is the first Bayesian graph-conditioned LoRA framework.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，它是第一个贝叶斯图条件LoRA框架。

sentences.en: It infers a latent interaction graph from the input and uses it to generate input-conditioned LoRA updates.
sentences.zh: 它从输入中推断潜在交互图，并用它生成输入条件化的LoRA更新。

sentences.en: As a result, iLoRA learns prediction and latent interaction structure jointly, rather than training a predictor and applying interaction analysis only post hoc.
sentences.zh: 因此，iLoRA联合学习预测与潜在交互结构，而非训练预测器后仅做事后交互分析。

sentences.en: We instantiate this idea for microbiome diagnosis, where disease state can depend on both species-level abundance and microbe–microbe cross-talk, and evaluate it in two complementary settings: interactive QA with human-annotated graphs, which tests latent structure recovery, and multi-cohort IBD diagnosis, which tests biomedical utility.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一想法实例化用于微生物组诊断，其中疾病状态可能同时取决于物种级丰度和微生物-微生物串扰，并在两个互补设置中评估它：带人工标注图的交互式问答，测试潜在结构恢复；以及多队列IBD诊断，测试生物医学实用性。

sentences.en: Across both settings, iLoRA improves over strong LoRA and Bayesian adaptation baselines, recovers graphs aligned with human annotations and cohort-level microbiome associations, and provides calibrated uncertainty with moderate graph-branch overhead.
sentences.zh: 在两种设置中，iLoRA都优于强LoRA和贝叶斯适配基线，恢复了与人工标注和队列级微生物组关联对齐的图，并以适度的图分支开销提供了校准的不确定性。

title_en: Image Restoration via Diffusion Models with Dynamic Resolution
title_zh: 带动态分辨率的扩散模型图像恢复

sentences.en: Diffusion models (DMs) have exhibited remarkable efficacy in various image restoration tasks.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型（DM）在多样图像恢复任务中展现出显著的效能。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches typically operate within the high-dimensional pixel space, resulting in high computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常在高维像素空间中运行，导致较高的计算开销。

sentences.en: While methods based on latent DMs seek to alleviate this issue by utilizing the compressed latent space of a variational autoencoder, they require repeated encoder-decoder inference.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于潜在DM的方法试图通过利用变分自编码器的压缩潜在空间来缓解这一问题，但它们需要重复的编码器-解码器推断。

sentences.en: This introduces significant additional computational burdens, often resulting in runtime performance that is even inferior to that of their pixel-space counterparts.
sentences.zh: 这引入了显著的额外计算负担，往往导致甚至逊于其像素空间对应方法的运行时性能。

sentences.en: To mitigate the computational inefficiency, this work proposes projecting data into lower-dimensional subspaces using dynamic resolution DMs to accelerate the inference process.
sentences.zh: 为缓解计算低效，这项工作提议使用动态分辨率DM将数据投影到较低维子空间以加速推断过程。

sentences.en: We first fine-tune pre-trained DMs for dynamic resolution priors and adapt DPS and DAPS, which are two widely used pixel-space methods for general image restoration tasks, into the proposed framework, yielding methods we refer to as SubDPS and SubDAPS, respectively.
sentences.zh: 我们首先为动态分辨率先验微调预训练的DM，并将DPS和DAPS（两种广泛用于一般图像恢复任务的像素空间方法）适配到所提出的框架中，产生我们分别称为SubDPS和SubDAPS的方法。

sentences.en: Given the favorable inference speed and reconstruction fidelity of SubDAPS, we introduce an enhanced variant termed SubDAPS++ to further boost both reconstruction efficiency and quality.
sentences.zh: 鉴于SubDAPS优异的推断速度和重建保真度，我们引入了称为SubDAPS++的增强变体，以进一步同时提升重建效率和重建质量。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations across diverse image datasets and various restoration tasks demonstrate that the proposed methods outperform recent DM-based approaches in the majority of experimental scenarios.
sentences.zh: 跨多样图像数据集和多种恢复任务的实证评估表明，所提出的方法在大多数实验场景中优于近期基于DM的方法。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/StarNextDay/SubDAPS.git.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/StarNextDay/SubDAPS.git 获取。

title_en: Image-to-Brain Signal Generation for Visual Prosthesis with CLIP Guided Multimodal Diffusion Models
title_zh: 用CLIP引导多模态扩散模型为视觉假体生成图像到脑信号

sentences.en: Visual prostheses hold great promise for restoring vision in blind individuals.
sentences.zh: 视觉假体在恢复盲人视力方面展现出巨大前景。

sentences.en: While researchers have successfully utilized M/EEG signals to evoke visual perceptions during the brain decoding stage of visual prostheses, the complementary process of converting images into M/EEG signals in the brain encoding stage remains largely unexplored, hindering the formation of a complete functional pipeline.
sentences.zh: 虽然研究人员已在视觉假体的脑解码阶段成功利用M/EEG信号唤起视觉感知，但与之互补的、在脑编码阶段将图像转换为M/EEG信号的过程在很大程度上仍未探索，阻碍了完整功能流水线的形成。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a novel image-to-brain signal framework that generates M/EEG from images by leveraging the diffusion transformer architecture enhanced with cross-attention mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个新颖的图像到脑信号框架，它通过利用带有交叉注意力机制增强的扩散transformer架构，从图像生成M/EEG。

sentences.en: Specifically, we employ a diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture based on denoising diffusion implicit models (DDIM) to achieve brain signal generation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们采用一种基于去噪扩散隐模型（DDIM）的扩散transformer（DiT）架构来实现脑信号生成。

sentences.en: To realize the goal of image-to-brain signal conversion, we use cross-attention mechanisms to align brain signal embeddings with CLIP image embeddings.
sentences.zh: 为实现图像到脑信号转换的目标，我们使用交叉注意力机制将脑信号嵌入与CLIP图像嵌入对齐。

sentences.en: Moreover, we leverage large language models (LLMs) to generate image captions, and concatenate the resulting CLIP text embeddings with CLIP image embeddings to form unified embeddings for cross-attention alignment, enabling our model to capture core semantic information.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们利用大语言模型（LLM）生成图像描述，并将所得的CLIP文本嵌入与CLIP图像嵌入拼接，形成统一嵌入用于交叉注意力对齐，使我们的模型能够捕获核心语义信息。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a learnable spatio-temporal position encoding that combines brain region embeddings with temporal embeddings to capture both spatial and temporal characteristics of brain signals.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了一种可学习的时空位置编码，它将脑区嵌入与时间嵌入相结合，以捕获脑信号的空间和时间特征。

sentences.en: We evaluate the framework on two multimodal benchmark datasets (THINGS-EEG2 and THINGS-MEG) and demonstrate that it generates biologically plausible brain signals.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个多模态基准数据集（THINGS-EEG2和THINGS-MEG）上评估该框架，并证明它能生成生物学上合理的脑信号。

title_en: Imagination Helps Visual Reasoning, But Not Yet in Latent Space
title_zh: 想象力有助视觉推理，但在潜在空间中尚未如此

sentences.en: Latent visual reasoning aims to mimic human's *imagination* process by meditating through hidden states of Multimodal Large Language Models.
sentences.zh: 潜在视觉推理旨在通过在多模态大语言模型的隐藏状态中沉思，来模仿人类的*想象*过程。

sentences.en: While recognized as a promising paradigm for visual reasoning, the underlying mechanisms driving its effectiveness remain unclear.
sentences.zh: 虽然被认为是一种有前景的视觉推理范式，但其有效性背后的底层机制仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Motivated to demystify the true source of its efficacy, we investigate the validity of latent reasoning using Causal Mediation Analysis.
sentences.zh: 受"揭开其效果真实来源"这一动机驱动，我们使用因果介导分析研究潜在推理的有效性。

sentences.en: We model the process as a causal chain: the input as the treatment, the latent tokens as the mediator, and the final answer as the outcome.
sentences.zh: 我们将该过程建模为一个因果链：输入作为处理，潜在词元作为中介，最终答案作为结果。

sentences.en: Our findings uncover two critical disconnections:    (a) **Input-Latent Disconnect**: dramatic perturbations on the input result in negligible changes to the latent tokens, suggesting that latent tokens do not effectively attend to the input sequence.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示了两处关键脱节：（a）**输入-潜在脱节**：对输入的剧烈扰动仅导致潜在词元可忽略的变化，表明潜在词元并未有效关注输入序列。

sentences.en: (b) **Latent-Answer Disconnect**: perturbations on the latent tokens yield minimal impact on the final answer, indicating the limited causal effect latent tokens imposing on the outcome.
sentences.zh: （b）**潜在-答案脱节**：对潜在词元的扰动对最终答案影响甚微，表明潜在词元对结果施加的因果效应有限。

sentences.en: Furthermore, extensive probing analysis reveals that latent tokens encode limited visual information and exhibit high similarity.
sentences.zh: 此外，广泛的探测分析揭示，潜在词元编码的视觉信息有限且表现出高度相似性。

sentences.en: Consequently, we challenge the necessity of latent reasoning and propose a straightforward alternative named *CapImagine*, which teaches the model to explicitly *imagine* using text.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们质疑潜在推理的必要性，并提出一个直接的替代方案，称为*CapImagine*，它教模型用文本显式地*想象*。

sentences.en: Experiments on vision-centric benchmarks show that *CapImagine* significantly outperforms complex latent-space baselines, highlighting the superior potential of visual reasoning through explicit imagination.
sentences.zh: 在视觉中心基准上的实验表明，*CapImagine*显著优于复杂的潜在空间基线，凸显了通过显式想象进行视觉推理的优越潜力。

title_en: ImgCoT: Compressing Long Chain of Thought into Compact Visual Tokens for Efficient Reasoning of Large Language Model
title_zh: ImgCoT：将长思维链压缩为紧凑视觉词元以实现大语言模型的高效推理

sentences.en: Compressing long chains of thought (CoT) into compact latent tokens is crucial for efficient reasoning with large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 将长思维链（CoT）压缩为紧凑潜在词元对于大语言模型（LLM）的高效推理至关重要。

sentences.en: Recent studies employ autoencoders to achieve this by reconstructing textual CoT from latent tokens, thus encoding CoT semantics.
sentences.zh: 近期研究采用自编码器来实现这一点，通过从潜在词元重建文本CoT，从而对CoT语义进行编码。

sentences.en: However, treating textual CoT as the reconstruction target forces latent tokens to preserve surface-level linguistic features (e.g., word choice and syntax), introducing a strong linguistic inductive bias that prioritizes linguistic form over reasoning structure and limits logical abstraction.
sentences.zh: 然而，将文本CoT视为重建目标会迫使潜在词元保留表层语言特征（如措词和句法），引入一种强烈的语言归纳偏置，它优先考虑语言形式而非推理结构，并限制逻辑抽象。

sentences.en: Thus, we propose ImgCoT that replaces the reconstruction target from textual CoT to the visual CoT obtained by rendering CoT into images.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了ImgCoT，它将重建目标从文本CoT替换为通过将CoT渲染为图像而获得的视觉CoT。

sentences.en: This substitutes linguistic bias with spatial inductive bias, i.e., a tendency to model spatial layouts of the reasoning steps in visual CoT, enabling latent tokens to better capture global reasoning structure.
sentences.zh: 这用空间归纳偏置替代了语言偏置，即倾向于建模视觉CoT中推理步骤的空间布局，使潜在词元能够更好地捕获全局推理结构。

sentences.en: Moreover, although visual latent tokens encode abstract reasoning structure, they may blur reasoning details.
sentences.zh: 此外，尽管视觉潜在词元编码了抽象推理结构，但它们可能模糊推理细节。

sentences.en: We thus propose a loose ImgCoT, a hybrid reasoning that augments visual latent tokens with a few key textual reasoning steps, selected based on low token log-likelihood.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了一个宽松的ImgCoT，一种混合推理方法，它用少量基于低词元对数似然选择的、关键的文本推理步骤来增强视觉潜在词元。

sentences.en: This design allows LLMs to retain both global reasoning structure and fine-grained reasoning details with fewer tokens than the complete CoT. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and LLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of the two versions of ImgCoT.
sentences.zh: 这种设计允许LLM以比完整CoT更少的词元保留全局推理结构和细粒度推理细节。跨多个数据集和LLM的大量实验证明了ImgCoT两个版本的有效性。

title_en: Imitation Learning for Multi-turn LM Agents via On-policy Expert Corrections
title_zh: 通过策略上专家纠正进行多轮LM智能体的模仿学习

sentences.en: A popular paradigm for training LM agents relies on imitation learning, fine-tuning on expert trajectories.
sentences.zh: 训练LM智能体的一种流行范式依赖模仿学习，即在专家轨迹上进行微调。

sentences.en: However, we show that the off-policy nature of imitation learning for multi-turn LM agents suffers from the fundamental limitation known as covariate shift: as the student policy's behavior diverges from the expert's, it encounters states not present in the training data, reducing the effectiveness of fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们表明多轮LM智能体的模仿学习的策略外性质遭受被称为协变量偏移的根本性局限：随着学生策略的行为偏离专家，它会遇到训练数据中不存在的状态，从而降低微调的有效性。

sentences.en: Taking inspiration from the classic DAgger algorithm, we propose a novel data generation methodology for addressing covariate shift for multi-turn LLM training.
sentences.zh: 受经典DAgger算法的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的数据生成方法，以应对多轮LLM训练的协变量偏移。

sentences.en: We introduce on-policy expert corrections (OECs), partially on-policy data generated by starting rollouts with a student model and then switching to an expert model part way through the trajectory.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了策略上专家纠正（OEC），一种部分策略内的数据，通过用学生模型启动展开，然后在轨迹中途切换到专家模型来生成。

sentences.en: We explore the effectiveness of our data generation technique in the domain of software engineering (SWE) tasks, a multi-turn setting where LLM agents must interact with a development environment to fix software bugs.
sentences.zh: 我们在软件工程（SWE）任务领域探索我们数据生成技术的有效性，这是一个多轮设置，其中LLM智能体必须与开发环境交互以修复软件缺陷。

sentences.en: Our experiments compare OEC data against various other on-policy and imitation learning approaches on SWE agent problems and train models using a common rejection sampling (i.e., using environment reward) combined with supervised fine-tuning technique.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验将OEC数据与SWE智能体问题上的各种其他策略内和模仿学习方法进行比较，并使用一种常见的拒采（即利用环境奖励）结合监督微调技术来训练模型。

sentences.en: Experiments find that OEC trajectories show a relative 14% and 13% improvement over traditional imitation learning in the 7b and 32b setting, respectively, on SWE-bench verified.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验将OEC数据与SWE智能体问题上的各种其他策略内和模仿学习方法进行比较，并使用一种常见的拒绝采样（即利用环境奖励）结合监督微调技术来训练模型。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate the need for combining expert demonstrations with on-policy data for effective multi-turn LM agent training.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果证明了将专家演示与策略内数据相结合对于有效多轮LM智能体训练的必要性。

title_en: ImmersePro: End-to-End Stereo Video Synthesis Via Implicit Disparity Learning
title_zh: ImmersePro：通过隐式视差学习的端到端立体视频合成

sentences.en: We introduce \textit{ImmersePro}, an innovative framework specifically designed to transform single-view videos into stereo videos.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了\textit{ImmersePro}，一个专门设计用于将单视点视频转换为立体视频的创新框架。

sentences.en: This framework utilizes a novel dual-branch architecture comprising a disparity branch and a context branch on video data by leveraging spatial-temporal attention mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 该框架采用一种新颖的双分支架构，通过利用时空注意力机制在视频数据上包含一个视差分支和一个上下文分支。

sentences.en: \textit{ImmersePro} employs implicit disparity guidance, enabling the generation of stereo pairs from video sequences without the need for explicit disparity maps, thus reducing potential errors associated with disparity estimation models.
sentences.zh: \textit{ImmersePro}采用隐式视差引导，使视频序列能够生成立体对，而无需显式视差图，从而减少了与视差估计模型相关的潜在误差。

sentences.en: In addition to the technical advancements, we introduce the YouTube-SBS dataset, a comprehensive collection of 423 stereo videos sourced from YouTube.
sentences.zh: 除技术进展外，我们引入了YouTube-SBS数据集，一个从YouTube获取的423个立体视频的综合集合。

sentences.en: This dataset is unprecedented in its scale, featuring over 7 million stereo pairs, and is designed to facilitate training and benchmarking of stereo video generation models.
sentences.zh: 该数据集在规模上前所未有，包含超过700万对立体对，旨在促进立体视频生成模型的训练和基准测试。

sentences.en: Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of \textit{ImmersePro} in producing high-quality stereo videos, offering significant improvements over existing methods.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验证明了\textit{ImmersePro}在生成高质量立体视频方面的有效性，相比现有方法带来了显著改进。

sentences.en: Compared to the best competitor stereo-from-mono we quantitatively improve the results by 11.76\% (L1), 6.39\% (SSIM), and 5.10\% (PSNR).
sentences.zh: 与最佳竞争对手stereo-from-mono相比，我们定量地将结果提升了11.76\%（L1）、6.39\%（SSIM）和5.10\%（PSNR）。

title_en: Immuno-VLM: Immunizing Large Vision-Language Models via Generative Semantic Antibodies for Open-World Trustworthiness
title_zh: Immuno-VLM：通过生成式语义抗体为开放世界可信性免疫大型视觉-语言模型

sentences.en: Large Vision-Language Models have achieved unprecedented success in zero-shot recognition by aligning visual features with broad semantic concepts.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉-语言模型通过将视觉特征与广泛语义概念对齐，在零样本识别方面取得了前所未有的成功。

sentences.en: However, this semantic abstraction creates a critical vulnerability in open-world deployment: the "Hubris of Semantics", where models force-fit unknown anomalies into known categories with high confidence due to the lack of explicit negative knowledge.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种语义抽象在开放世界部署中创造了一个关键脆弱性：“语义傲慢”，即由于缺乏显式的负知识，模型将未知异常强行归入已知类别并给出高置信度。

sentences.en: To address this Open-World Trustworthiness Paradox, we propose Immuno-VLM, a bio-inspired framework that adapts the biological principle of Immunological Negative Selection to high-dimensional latent spaces.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一开放世界可信性悖论，我们提出了Immuno-VLM，一个受生物启发的框架，它将免疫学负选择的生物学原理适配到高维潜在空间中。

sentences.en: Departing from traditional Open-Set Recognition  methods that rely on passive density estimation or inefficient pixel-space outlier generation, Immuno-VLM leverages the generative reasoning of Large Language Models  to actively hallucinate "Semantic Antibodies", textual descriptions of near-distribution outliers (e.g., look-alikes, contextual anomalies) that effectively bound the decision space of known classes.
sentences.zh: 与依赖被动密度估计或低效像素空间离群值生成的传统开集识别方法不同，Immuno-VLM利用大语言模型的生成式推理主动地幻觉出“语义抗体”，即近分布离群值（如相似物、上下文异常）的文本描述，从而有效地限定已知类别的决策空间。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K and four challenging OOD benchmarks reveal that Immuno-VLM establishes a new state-of-the-art.
sentences.zh: 在ImageNet-1K和四个具有挑战性的OOD基准上进行的大量实验表明，Immuno-VLM建立了新的最先进水平。

title_en: Impact of Connectivity on Laplacian Representations in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 连通性对强化学习中Laplacian表示的影响

sentences.en: Learning compact state representations in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) has proven crucial for addressing the curse of dimensionality in large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) problems.
sentences.zh: 在马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中学习紧凑的状态表示已被证明对解决大规模强化学习（RL）问题中的维数灾难至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing principled approaches leverage structural priors on the MDP by constructing state representations as linear combinations of the state-graph Laplacian eigenvectors.
sentences.zh: 现有的有原则方法利用MDP上的结构先验，将状态表示构建为状态图Laplacian特征向量的线性组合。

sentences.en: When the transition graph is unknown or the state space is prohibitively large, the graph spectral features can be estimated directly via sample trajectories.
sentences.zh: 当转移图未知或状态空间大到令人望而却步时，图谱特征可以通过样本轨迹直接估计。

sentences.en: In this work, we prove an upper bound on the approximation error of linear value function approximation under the learned spectral features.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们证明了在所学习的谱特征下线性值函数逼近的近似误差的一个上界。

sentences.en: We show how this error scales with the algebraic connectivity of the state-graph, grounding the approximation quality in the topological structure of the MDP.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了该误差如何随状态图的代数连通性缩放，将逼近质量植根于MDP的拓扑结构。

sentences.en: We further bound the error introduced by the eigenvector estimation itself, leading to an end-to-end error decomposition across the representation learning pipeline.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步界定了特征向量估计本身引入的误差，从而在表示学习流水线上产生了端到端的误差分解。

sentences.en: Additionally, we show how the common expression for the symmetrized MDP Laplacian is easy to misinterpret, and propose a more straightforward reformulation.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们展示了对称化MDP Laplacian的常见表达式如何容易被误解，并提出了一种更直接的重新表述。

sentences.en: Our results hold for general (non-uniform) policies without any assumptions on the symmetry of the induced transition kernel.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果对一般（非均匀）策略成立，无需对诱导转移核的对称性作任何假设。

sentences.en: We validate our theoretical findings with numerical simulations on gridworld environments.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在gridworld环境上的数值模拟验证了我们的理论发现。

title_en: IMPACT: Influence Modeling for Open-Set Time Series Anomaly Detection
title_zh: IMPACT：开放集时间序列异常检测的影响建模

sentences.en: Open-set anomaly detection (OSAD) is an emerging paradigm designed to utilize limited labeled data from anomaly classes seen in training to identify both seen and unseen anomalies during testing.
sentences.zh: 开放集异常检测（OSAD）是一种新兴范式，旨在利用训练中见过的异常类别的有限标注数据，在测试时识别见过和未见过的异常。

sentences.en: Current approaches rely on simple augmentation methods to generate pseudo anomalies that replicate unseen anomalies.
sentences.zh: 当前方法依赖简单的增强方法生成复制未见异常的伪异常。

sentences.en: Despite being promising in image data, these methods are found to be ineffective in time series data due to the failure to preserve its sequential nature, resulting in trivial or unrealistic anomaly patterns.
sentences.zh: 尽管在图像数据上很有前景，但人们发现这些方法在时间序列数据上效果不佳，因为它们未能保留序列的自然性质，导致琐碎或不真实的异常模式。

sentences.en: They are further plagued when the training data is contaminated with unlabeled anomalies.
sentences.zh: 当训练数据被未标注异常污染时，它们会进一步受到困扰。

sentences.en: This work introduces $\textbf{IMPACT}$, a novel framework that leverages $\underline{\textbf{i}}$nfluence $\underline{\textbf{m}}$odeling for o$\underline{\textbf{p}}$en-set time series $\underline{\textbf{a}}$nomaly dete$\underline{\textbf{ct}}$ion, to tackle these challenges.
sentences.zh: 这项工作引入了$\textbf{IMPACT}$，一个新框架，它利用$\underline{\textbf{i}}$nfluence $\underline{\textbf{m}}$odeling for o$\underline{\textbf{p}}$en-set time series $\underline{\textbf{a}}$nomaly dete$\underline{\textbf{ct}}$ion，以应对这些挑战。

sentences.en: The key insight is to $\textbf{i)}$ learn an influence function that can accurately estimate the impact of individual training samples on the modeling, and then $\textbf{ii)}$ leverage these influence scores to generate semantically divergent yet realistic unseen anomalies for time series while repurposing high-influential samples as supervised anomalies for anomaly decontamination.
sentences.zh: 关键洞见是：$\textbf{i)}$ 学习一个影响函数，它能准确估计单个训练样本对建模的影响，然后 $\textbf{ii)}$ 利用这些影响分数为时间序列生成语义发散而逼真的未见异常，同时将高影响样本重新用作监督异常以实现异常去污。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that IMPACT significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, showing superior accuracy under varying OSAD settings and contamination rates.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，IMPACT显著优于现有最先进方法，在各种OSAD设置和污染率下都展现出卓越的准确率。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/mala-lab/IMPACT.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/mala-lab/IMPACT 获取。

title_en: Implicit Action Chunking for Smooth Continuous Control
title_zh: 用于平滑连续控制的隐式动作分块

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning often produces high-frequency oscillatory control signals that undermine the safety and stability required for physical deployment.
sentences.zh: 强化学习常常产生高频振荡的控制信号，这损害了物理部署所需的安全性和稳定性。

sentences.en: Explicit action chunking addresses this by predicting fixed-horizon trajectories but scales the policy output dimension proportionally with the horizon length, leading to optimization difficulties and incompatibility with standard step-wise interaction.
sentences.zh: 显式动作分块通过预测固定时域轨迹来应对这一点，但策略输出维度随时域长度成比例扩展，导致优化困难并不兼容标准逐步交互。

sentences.en: To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes Dual-Window Smoothing (DWS), an implicit action chunking framework for smooth continuous control.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些挑战，本文提出了双窗口平滑（DWS），一个用于平滑连续控制的隐式动作分块框架。

sentences.en: Unlike explicit methods, DWS enforces temporal coherence without expanding the action space.
sentences.zh: 与显式方法不同，DWS在不扩展动作空间的情况下强制时间一致性。

sentences.en: It uses a dual-window design: an execution window that ensures physical smoothness through deterministic modulation, and a value window that aligns temporal-difference targets over the horizon to correct critic bias caused by open-loop execution.
sentences.zh: 它采用双窗口设计：一个执行窗口，通过确定性调制确保物理平滑性；以及一个价值窗口，在时域上对齐时序差分目标，以纠正由开环执行引起的评判者偏差。

sentences.en: DWS also includes a lightweight actor-side temporal regularizer based on first-order action differences to promote global continuity.
sentences.zh: DWS还包含一个基于一阶动作差异的轻量级actor侧时间正则化器，以促进全局连续性。

sentences.en: This design effectively bridges the gap between temporal abstraction and reactive step-wise control.
sentences.zh: 这种设计有效地弥合了时间抽象与反应式逐步控制之间的差距。

sentences.en: Experiments on benchmarks including the DeepMind Control Suite and industrial energy management tasks show that DWS outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines.
sentences.zh: 在包括DeepMind Control Suite和工业能源管理任务的基准上的实验表明，DWS优于最先进（SOTA）基线。

sentences.en: In complex vision-based autonomous driving tasks, DWS achieves smoother control, safer behavior with reduced jitter, and attains a 100% success rate.
sentences.zh: 在复杂的基于视觉的自动驾驶任务中，DWS实现了更平滑的控制、更安全的行为（抖动减少），并达到了100%的成功率。

title_en: Implicit Actor Critic Coupling via a Supervised Learning Framework for RLVR
title_zh: 用于RLVR的通过监督学习框架实现的隐式Actor-Critic耦合

sentences.en: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have empowered large language models (LLMs) to tackle challenging reasoning tasks such as mathematics and programming, however existing RLVR methods often suffer from sparse reward signals and unstable policy gradient updates inherent to RL-based approaches.
sentences.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）的近期进展赋予了大语言模型（LLM）处理诸如数学和编程等挑战性推理任务的能力，然而现有RLVR方法往往遭受稀疏奖励信号和RL方法固有的不稳定策略梯度更新的困扰。

sentences.en: To address the challenges, we propose $\textbf{PACS}$, a novel RLVR framework that achieves im$\textbf{P}$licit $\textbf{A}$ctor $\textbf{C}$ritic coupling via a $\textbf{S}$upervised learning framework.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了$\textbf{PACS}$，一个新颖的RLVR框架，它通过$\textbf{S}$upervised学习框架实现im$\textbf{P}$licit $\textbf{A}$ctor $\textbf{C}$ritic耦合。

sentences.en: By treating the outcome reward as a predictable label, we reformulate the RLVR problem into a supervised learning task over a score function parameterized by the policy model and optimized using cross-entropy loss.
sentences.zh: 通过将结果奖励视为一个可预测标签，我们将RLVR问题重新表述为一个在由策略模型参数化的评分函数上的监督学习任务，并使用交叉熵损失进行优化。

sentences.en: A detailed gradient analysis shows that this supervised formulation inherently recovers the classical policy gradient update while providing more stable and efficient training.
sentences.zh: 详细的梯度分析表明，这种监督公式在提供更稳定和高效训练的同时，固有地恢复了经典策略梯度更新。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that PACS significantly outperforms strong open-source models and RLVR baselines, yielding substantial average gains of $\textbf{+8.26\%}$ (4B) and $\textbf{+9.57\%}$ (8B) over base models offering a promising avenue for LLMs post-training with verifiable rewards.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，PACS显著优于强开源模型和RLVR基线，在基础模型之上取得了$\textbf{+8.26\%}$（4B）和$\textbf{+9.57\%}$（8B）的显著平均增益，为带可验证奖励的LLM后训练提供了一条有前景的途径。

sentences.en: Our code and data are available as open source at https://github.com/ritzz-ai/PACS.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码和数据在 https://github.com/ritzz-ai/PACS 以开源形式公开。

title_en: Implicit Intelligence - Evaluating Agents on What Users Don’t Say
title_zh: 隐性智能——评估用户未言明之事的智能体

sentences.en: Real-world requests to AI agents are fundamentally underspecified.
sentences.zh: 对AI智能体的真实世界请求从根本上就是欠明确的。

sentences.en: Natural human communication relies on shared context and unstated constraints that speakers expect listeners to infer.
sentences.zh: 自然的人类沟通依赖共享上下文和未言明的约束，说话者期望听者去推断。

sentences.en: Current agentic benchmarks test explicit instruction-following but fail to evaluate whether agents can reason about implicit requirements spanning accessibility needs, privacy boundaries, catastrophic risks, and contextual constraints.
sentences.zh: 当前的智能体基准测试显式指令遵循，但未能评估智能体是否能够对涵盖可达性需求、隐私边界、灾难性风险和上下文约束的隐性要求进行推理。

sentences.en: We present **Implicit Intelligence**, an evaluation framework testing whether AI agents can move beyond prompt-following to become genuine goal-fulfillers, paired with **Agent-as-a-World (AaW)**, a harness where interactive worlds are defined in human-readable YAML files and simulated by language models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了**Implicit Intelligence**，一个评估框架，测试AI智能体能否超越提示遵循而成为真正的目标完成者，并配套**Agent-as-a-World（AaW）**，一个用人类可读YAML文件定义交互世界并由语言模型模拟的测试平台。

sentences.en: Our scenarios feature apparent simplicity in user requests, hidden complexity in correct solutions, and discoverability of constraints through environmental exploration.
sentences.zh: 我们的场景以用户请求的表观简单性、正确解中的隐藏复杂性，以及通过环境探索发现约束的可能性为特征。

sentences.en: Evaluating 16 frontier and open-weight models across 205 scenarios, we find that even the best-performing model achieves only 48.3% scenario pass rate, revealing substantial room for improvement in bridging the gap between literal instruction-following and human-like contextual reasoning.
sentences.zh: 在205个场景中评估16个前沿和开放权重模型，我们发现即使表现最好的模型也仅达到48.3%的场景通过率，揭示了在弥合字面指令遵循与人式上下文推理之间的差距方面仍有巨大的改进空间。

title_en: Implicit Preference Alignment  for Human Image Animation
title_zh: 用于人体图像动画的隐式偏好对齐

sentences.en: Human image animation has witnessed significant advancements, yet generating high-fidelity hand motions remains a persistent challenge due to their high degrees of freedom and motion complexity.
sentences.zh: 人体图像动画已取得显著进展，但由于手部运动具有高度自由度和运动复杂性，生成高保真手部运动仍是一个持续的挑战。

sentences.en: While reinforcement learning from human feedback, particularly direct preference optimization, offers a potential solution, it necessitates the construction of strict preference pairs.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于人类反馈的强化学习（尤其是直接偏好优化）提供了潜在的解决方案，但它需要构建严格的偏好对。

sentences.en: However, curating such pairs for dynamic hand regions is prohibitively expensive and often impractical due to frame-wise inconsistencies.
sentences.zh: 然而，为动态手部区域整理此类对代价高昂得令人望而却步，且由于逐帧不一致往往不切实际。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Implicit Preference Alignment (IPA), a data-efficient post-training framework that eliminates the need for paired preference data.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了隐式偏好对齐（IPA），一个数据高效的后训练框架，它消除了对配对偏好数据的需求。

sentences.en: Theoretically grounded in implicit reward maximization, IPA aligns the model by maximizing the likelihood of self-generated high-quality samples while penalizing deviations from the pretrained prior.
sentences.zh: 在理论上植根于隐式奖励最大化，IPA通过最大化自生成高质量样本的似然，同时惩罚对预训练先验的偏离来对齐模型。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a Hand-Aware Local Optimization mechanism to explicitly steer the alignment process toward hand regions.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了一种手部感知局部优化机制，以显式地将对齐过程引导向手部区域。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves effective preference optimization to enhance hand generation quality, while significantly lowering the barrier for constructing preference data.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的方法实现了有效的偏好优化以提升手部生成质量，同时显著降低了构建偏好数据的门槛。

sentences.en: Codes are released at https://github.com/mdswyz/IPA
sentences.zh: 代码在 https://github.com/mdswyz/IPA 发布。

authors.name: bing ma
authors.institution: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

title_en: Implicit Safety Alignment from Crowd Preferences
title_zh: 从群体偏好进行隐式安全对齐

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) can reveal implicit objectives such as safety considerations that go beyond task completion.
sentences.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可以揭示超越任务完成的隐式目标，如安全考量。

sentences.en: In this work, we focus on the common safety criteria embedded in crowd preference datasets, where different users may express distinct preferences or objectives, yet follow similar safety principles.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们聚焦于嵌入在群体偏好数据集中的常见安全准则，其中不同用户可能表达不同的偏好或目标，却遵循相似的安全原则。

sentences.en: Our aim is to discover shared safety criteria from crowd preferences and then transfer them to downstream RL tasks to regularize agent behavior and enforce safety.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是发现群体偏好中共享的安全准则，然后将其迁移到下游RL任务，以正则化智能体行为并强制安全性。

sentences.en: We first show that direct reward combination—optimizing a preference-learned reward model together with downstream task rewards—has inherent limitations.
sentences.zh: 我们首先表明，直接奖励组合——将偏好学习的奖励模型与下游任务奖励一起优化——具有固有限制。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose Safe Crowd Preference-based RL, a hierarchical framework that extracts safety-aligned skills from crowd preferences and composes them via a high-level policy to safely solve downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出了安全群体偏好RL，一个层级框架，它从群体偏好中提取安全对齐技能，并通过一个高层策略组合它们，以安全地解决下游任务。

sentences.en: Experiments across safe RL environments and a preliminary LLM-style task with diverse user goals and shared safety constraints demonstrate that our approach substantially lowers safety costs without access to explicit safety rewards, while achieving task performance comparable to oracle methods trained with ground-truth safety signals.
sentences.zh: 在安全RL环境和一项具有多样化用户目标与共享安全约束的初步LLM风格任务上的实验表明，我们的方法在无法获得显式安全奖励的情况下大幅降低了安全成本，同时取得了与使用真实安全信号训练的oracle方法相当的任务性能。

title_en: Implicit Turn-Wise Policy Optimization for Proactive User-LLM Interaction
title_zh: 用于主动用户-LLM交互的隐式轮次级策略优化

sentences.en: Multi-turn human-AI collaboration is fundamental to deploying interactive services such as adaptive tutoring, conversational recommendation, and professional consultation.
sentences.zh: 多轮人机协作是部署自适应辅导、对话式推荐和专业咨询等交互式服务的基础。

sentences.en: However, optimizing these interactions via reinforcement learning is hindered by the sparsity of verifiable intermediate rewards and the high stochasticity of user responses.
sentences.zh: 然而，通过强化学习优化这些交互受到可验证中间奖励稀疏性以及用户响应高随机性的阻碍。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce Implicit Turn-wise Policy Optimization (ITPO).
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们引入了隐式轮次级策略优化（ITPO）。

sentences.en: ITPO leverages an implicit process reward model to derive fine-grained, turn-wise process rewards from sparse outcome signals.
sentences.zh: ITPO利用隐式过程奖励模型，从稀疏的结果信号中推导细粒度、轮次级的过程奖励。

sentences.en: Unlike volatile token-level rewards, these turn-level signals exhibit superior robustness and may utilize a normalization mechanism to further enhance training stability.
sentences.zh: 与易变的词元级奖励不同，这些轮级信号展现出卓越的鲁棒性，并可利用一种归一化机制进一步增强训练稳定性。

sentences.en: We evaluate ITPO across three representative multi-turn collaborative tasks: math tutoring, document writing, and medical recommendation.
sentences.zh: 我们在三个代表性的多轮协作任务上评估ITPO：数学辅导、文档写作和医疗推荐。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate that ITPO, when combined with PPO, GRPO, or RLOO, consistently achieves improved convergence than existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，ITPO与PPO、GRPO或RLOO结合时，持续比现有基线取得更好的收敛性。

sentences.en: Elaborate trajectory analysis confirms that ITPO infers turn-wise preferences that are semantically aligned with human judgment.
sentences.zh: 细致的轨迹分析证实，ITPO推断出的轮次级偏好与人类判断在语义上一致。

title_en: Imposing Boundary Conditions on Neural Operators via Learned Function Extensions
title_zh: 通过学习函数扩展对神经算子施加边界条件

sentences.en: Neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for the solution of partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their ability to handle general, highly variable boundary conditions (BCs) remains limited.
sentences.zh: 神经算子已涌现为求解偏微分方程（PDE）的强大代理模型，但它们在处理一般的、高度可变的边界条件（BC）方面的能力仍然有限。

sentences.en: Existing approaches often fail when the solution operator exhibits strong sensitivity to boundary forcings.
sentences.zh: 当解算子在边界强迫作用下表现出强敏感性时，现有方法往往会失效。

sentences.en: We propose a general framework for conditioning neural operators on complex non-homogeneous BCs through function extensions.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个通用框架，通过函数扩展使神经算子以复杂的非齐次BC为条件。

sentences.en: Our key idea is to map boundary data to latent pseudo-extensions defined over the entire spatial domain, enabling any standard operator learning architecture to consume boundary information.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键思想是将边界数据映射到定义在整个空间域上的潜在伪扩展，从而使任何标准的算子学习架构都能消费边界信息。

sentences.en: The resulting operator, coupled with an arbitrary domain-to-domain neural operator, can learn rich dependencies on complex BCs and input domain functions at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所得算子与任意域到域神经算子耦合，能够同时学习对复杂BC和输入域函数的丰富依赖。

sentences.en: To benchmark this setting, we construct 18 challenging datasets spanning Poisson, linear elasticity, and hyperelasticity problems, with highly variable, mixed-type, component-wise, and multi-segment BCs on diverse geometries.
sentences.zh: 为对该设置进行基准测试，我们构建了18个富有挑战性的数据集，涵盖Poisson、线性弹性和超弹性问题，并在多样几何上具有高度可变、混合类型、逐分量和多段BC。

sentences.en: Our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, outperforming baselines by large margins, while requiring no hyperparameter tuning across datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法取得了最先进的准确率，大幅超越基线，同时无需跨数据集进行超参数调优。

sentences.en: Overall, our results demonstrate that learning boundary-to-domain extensions is an effective and practical strategy for imposing complex BCs in existing neural operator frameworks, enabling accurate and robust scientific machine learning models for a broader range of PDE-governed problems.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，学习边界到域扩展是在现有神经算子框架中施加复杂BC的一种有效而实用的策略，为更广泛的PDE支配问题实现了准确而鲁棒的科学机器学习模型。

title_en: ImpQuant: Fine-Grained Importance-Aware Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models
title_zh: ImpQuant：面向大型视觉-语言模型的细粒度重要性感知量化

sentences.en: Large Vision–Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse multimodal tasks, yet their high inference costs necessitate low-bit deployment.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）在多样多模态任务上展现出卓越能力，但其高推断成本使得低位部署成为必要。

sentences.en: Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) pipelines primarily adopt methodologies from text-only LLMs by treating multimodal inputs as homogeneous sequences, overlooking the heterogeneous information density inherent in LVLMs.
sentences.zh: 现有的训练后量化（PTQ）流水线主要采用从纯文本LLM借鉴的方法，将多模态输入视为同质序列，忽视了LVLM固有的异质信息密度。

sentences.en: In this work, we present ImpQuant, an importance-aware PTQ framework tailored for LVLMs that mitigates low-bit accuracy degradation via fine-grained token-importance reweighted calibration and outlier-aware activation quantization.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了ImpQuant，一个专为LVLM定制的重要性感知PTQ框架，它通过细粒度的词元重要性重加权校准和离群值感知激活量化来缓解低位准确率下降。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that quantization errors on decision-critical tokens disproportionately impact overall model behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是，对决策关键词元的量化误差对整体模型行为的影响不成比例地大。

sentences.en: Accordingly, we reweight the calibration loss using aggregated attention for textual tokens and a contextual redundancy metric for visual tokens, respectively.
sentences.zh: 相应地，我们分别使用聚合注意力对文本词元、使用上下文冗余度量对视觉词元来对校准损失进行重加权。

sentences.en: Across multiple LVLM backbones and diverse multimodal benchmarks, our approach consistently improves accuracy at low bitwidth and reduces quantization-induced object hallucinations compared to state-of-the-art PTQ baselines.
sentences.zh: 跨多个LVLM骨干和多样多模态基准，我们的方法在低比特宽度下持续提升准确率，并与最先进的PTQ基线相比减少了由量化引起的物体幻觉。

title_en: Improved Algorithms for Nash Welfare in Linear Bandits
title_zh: 线性Bandit中Nash福利的改进算法

sentences.en: Nash regret has recently emerged as a principled fairness-aware performance metric for stochastic multi-armed bandits, motivated by the Nash Social Welfare objective.
sentences.zh: Nash遗憾近期已涌现为随机多臂bandit的一种有原则的公平感知性能度量，其动机来自Nash社会福利目标。

sentences.en: Although this notion has been extended to linear bandits, existing results suffer from suboptimality in ambient dimension $d$, stemming from proof techniques that rely on restrictive concentration inequalities.
sentences.zh: 尽管这一概念已被扩展到线性bandit，现有结果在环境维度 $d$ 上遭受次优性，这源于依赖限制性集中不等式的一证明技术。

sentences.en: In this work, we resolve this open problem by introducing new analytical tools that yield an order-optimal Nash regret bound in linear bandits.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过引入产生线性bandit中阶最优Nash遗憾界的新分析工具，解决了这一开放问题。

sentences.en: Beyond Nash regret, we initiate the study of $p$-means regret in linear bandits, a unifying framework that interpolates between fairness and utility objectives and strictly generalizes Nash regret.
sentences.zh: 超越Nash遗憾，我们启动了线性bandit中 $p$-均值遗憾的研究，这是一个在公平性与效用目标之间插值、并严格推广Nash遗憾的统一框架。

sentences.en: We propose a generic algorithmic framework, FairLinBandit, that works as a meta-algorithm on top of any linear bandit strategy.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个通用算法框架FairLinBandit，它在任何线性bandit策略之上充当元算法。

sentences.en: We instantiate this framework using two bandit algorithms: Phased Elimination and Upper Confidence Bound, and prove that both achieve sublinear $p$-means regret for the entire range of $p$.
sentences.zh: 我们使用两种bandit算法实例化该框架：阶段消除和上置信界，并证明两者在 $p$ 的整个范围内都能实现亚线性的 $p$-均值遗憾。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on linear bandit instances generated from real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods consistently outperform the existing state-of-the-art baseline.
sentences.zh: 在由真实世界数据集生成的线性bandit实例上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法持续优于现有最先进基线。

title_en: Improved Analysis of the Accelerated Noisy Power Method with Applications to Decentralized PCA
title_zh: 加速带噪幂方法的改进分析及其在去中心化PCA中的应用

sentences.en: We analyze the Accelerated Noisy Power Method, an algorithm for Principal Component Analysis in the setting where only inexact matrix-vector products are available, which can arise for instance in decentralized PCA.
sentences.zh: 我们分析了加速带噪幂方法，一种在仅有非精确矩阵-向量积可用（例如在去中心化PCA中可能出现）的情况下用于主分量分析（PCA）的算法。

sentences.en: While previous works have established that acceleration can improve convergence rates compared to the standard Noisy Power Method, these guarantees require overly restrictive upper bounds on the magnitude of the perturbations, limiting their practical applicability.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前工作已确立加速相比标准带噪幂方法能够改进收敛速率，但这些保证要求对扰动幅度施加过度限制性的上界，限制了其实用适用性。

sentences.en: We provide an improved analysis of this algorithm, which preserves the accelerated convergence rate under much milder conditions on the perturbations.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了该算法的改进分析，它在宽松得多的扰动条件下保留了加速收敛速率。

sentences.en: We show that our new analysis is worst-case optimal, in the sense that the convergence rate cannot be improved, and that the noise conditions we derive cannot be relaxed without sacrificing convergence guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们表明我们的新分析在 worst-case 意义上是最优的，即收敛速率无法被改进，且我们推导出的噪声条件在不牺牲收敛保证的情况下无法被放宽。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the practical relevance of our results by deriving an accelerated algorithm for decentralized PCA, which has similar communication costs to non-accelerated methods.
sentences.zh: 我们通过为去中心化PCA推导出一种加速算法，证明了我们结果的实际相关性，该算法与非加速方法具有相似的通信成本。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, this is the first decentralized algorithm for PCA with provably accelerated convergence.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是第一个具有可证明加速收敛的去中心化PCA算法。

title_en: Improved Bounds for Private and Robust Alignment
title_zh: 私密与鲁棒对齐的改进界

sentences.en: In this paper, we study the private and robust alignment of language models from a theoretical perspective by establishing upper bounds on the suboptimality gap in both offline and online settings.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们从理论角度研究语言模型的私密与鲁棒对齐，在离线和在线两种设置中建立次优性差距的上界。

sentences.en: We consider preference labels subject to privacy constraints and/or adversarial corruption, and analyze two distinct interplays between them: privacy-first and corruption-first.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑受隐私约束和/或对抗损坏约束的偏好标签，并分析它们之间的两种不同相互作用：隐私优先和损坏优先。

sentences.en: For the privacy-only setting, we show that log loss with an MLE-style algorithm achieves near-optimal rates, in contrast to conventional wisdom.
sentences.zh: 对于仅隐私的设置，我们表明使用MLE风格算法的log损失能达到近乎最优的速率，这与传统观点相反。

sentences.en: For the joint privacy-and-corruption setting, we first demonstrate that existing offline algorithms in fact provide stronger guarantees---simultaneously in terms of corruption level and privacy parameters---than previously known, which further yields improved bounds in the corruption-only regime.
sentences.zh: 对于隐私与损坏联合的设置，我们首先证明现有离线算法实际上提供了比先前已知更强的保证——同时在损坏水平和隐私参数方面——这进一步在仅损坏的机制中产生了改进的界。

sentences.en: In addition, we also present the first set of results for private and robust online alignment.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还呈现了私密与鲁棒在线对齐的第一组结果。

sentences.en: Our results are enabled by new uniform convergence guarantees for log loss and square loss under privacy and corruption, which we believe have broad applicability across learning theory and statistics.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果得益于在隐私和损坏下的log损失与平方损失的新的一致收敛保证，我们认为这些保证在学习理论和统计学中具有广泛的适用性。

title_en: Improved Bounds for Reward-Agnostic and Reward-Free Exploration
title_zh: 奖励无关与奖励自由探索的改进界

sentences.en: We study *reward-free* and *reward-agnostic* exploration in episodic finite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs), where an agent explores an unknown environment without observing external rewards.
sentences.zh: 我们研究情节式有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的*奖励自由*和*奖励无关*探索，其中智能体在未观测外部奖励的情况下探索未知环境。

sentences.en: Reward-free exploration aims to enable $\epsilon$-optimal policies for *any* reward revealed after exploration, while reward-agnostic exploration targets $\epsilon$-optimality for rewards drawn from a small finite class.
sentences.zh: 奖励自由探索旨在实现对探索后揭示的*任意*奖励的 $\epsilon$-最优策略，而奖励无关探索则针对从一个小型有限类中抽取的奖励的 $\epsilon$-最优性。

sentences.en: In the *reward-agnostic setting*, Li, Yan, Chen, and Fan (2024)  achieve minimax sample complexity, but only for restrictively small accuracy parameter $\epsilon$.
sentences.zh: 在*奖励无关设置*中，Li、Yan、Chen和Fan（2024）实现了极小极大样本复杂度，但仅针对限制性过强的小精度参数 $\epsilon$。

sentences.en: We propose a new algorithm that significantly relaxes the requirement on $\epsilon$.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种新算法，显著放宽了对 $\epsilon$ 的要求。

sentences.en: Our approach is novel and of technical interest by itself.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法本身具有新颖性和技术价值。

sentences.en: Our algorithm employs an online learning procedure with carefully designed rewards to construct an exploration policy, which is used to gather data sufficient for accurate dynamics estimation and subsequent computation of an $\epsilon$-optimal policy once the reward is revealed.
sentences.zh: 我们的算法采用一个带精心设计奖励的在线学习过程来构建探索策略，该策略用于收集足以进行精确动力学估计的数据，并在奖励揭示后随后计算一个 $\epsilon$-最优策略。

sentences.en: Finally, we establish a tight lower bound for *reward-free exploration*, closing the gap between known upper and lower bounds.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们为*奖励自由探索*建立了一个紧下界，弥合了已知上界与下界之间的差距。

title_en: Improved Convergence Analysis of Topology Dependence in Decentralized SGD
title_zh: 去中心化SGD中拓扑依赖性的改进收敛分析

sentences.en: Decentralized SGD is a fundamental algorithm in decentralized learning, although the influence of an underlying network topology on its convergence behavior is not yet fully understood.
sentences.zh: 去中心化SGD是去中心化学习中的一种基础算法，尽管底层网络拓扑对其收敛行为的影响尚未被完全理解。

sentences.en: Existing convergence analyses have shown that topologies with a small spectral gap significantly deteriorate the convergence rate of Decentralized SGD in both homogeneous and heterogeneous cases.
sentences.zh: 现有的收敛分析已表明，具有小谱间隙的拓扑在同质和异质两种情况下都会显著恶化去中心化SGD的收敛速率。

sentences.en: However, many prior papers have reported that indeed the choice of the topology has a significant experimental impact in the heterogeneous case, but has little experimental impact on training behavior in the homogeneous case.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多先前论文报告，拓扑的选择在异质情况下确实具有显著的实验影响，但在同质情况下对训练行为的影响很小。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present a tighter convergence analysis of Decentralized SGD, offering a more precise understanding of how topologies affect the convergence rate than the prior analysis.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了对去中心化SGD的更紧的收敛分析，相比先前分析提供了对拓扑如何影响收敛速率的更精确理解。

sentences.en: Specifically, unlike existing convergence analyses that used only the spectral gap as a property of the topology, our novel analysis shows that all eigenvalues of the mixing matrix affect the convergence rate.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，与仅使用谱间隙作为拓扑性质的现有收敛分析不同，我们的新颖分析表明混合矩阵的所有特征值都会影响收敛速率。

sentences.en: Throughout the experiments, we carefully evaluated the convergence behavior of Decentralized SGD and demonstrated that our novel convergence analysis can more accurately describe the effect of topology on the convergence rate.
sentences.zh: 在整个实验中，我们仔细评估了去中心化SGD的收敛行为，并证明我们的新颖收敛分析能够更准确地描述拓扑对收敛速率的影响。

title_en: Improved Convergence of Score-Based Diffusion Models via Prediction-Correction
title_zh: 通过预测-校正改进基于分数的扩散模型的收敛性

sentences.en: Score-based generative models (SGMs) are powerful tools to sample from complex data distributions.
sentences.zh: 基于分数的生成模型（SGM）是从复杂数据分布中采样的强大工具。

sentences.en: Their underlying idea is to \emph{(i)} run a forward process for time $T_1$ by adding noise to the data, \emph{(ii)} estimate its score function, and \emph{(iii)} use such estimate to run a reverse process.
sentences.zh: 其基本思想是\emph{（i）}对数据加噪运行时间 $T_1$ 的前向过程，\emph{（ii）}估计其分数函数，并 \emph{（iii）}利用该估计运行反向过程。

sentences.en: As the reverse process is initialized with the stationary distribution of the forward one, the existing analysis paradigm requires $T_1\to\infty$.
sentences.zh: 由于反向过程以前向过程的平稳分布初始化，现有分析范式要求 $T_1\to\infty$。

sentences.en: This is however problematic: from a theoretical viewpoint, for a given precision of the score approximation, the convergence guarantee fails as $T_1$ diverges; from a practical viewpoint, a large $T_1$ increases computational costs and leads to error propagation.
sentences.zh: 然而这是有问题的：从理论角度看，对于给定的分数近似精度，收敛保证会随 $T_1$ 发散而失效；从实践角度看，大的 $T_1$ 会增加计算成本并导致误差传播。

sentences.en: This paper addresses the issue by considering a version of the popular \emph{predictor-corrector} scheme: after running the forward process, we first estimate the final distribution via an inexact Langevin dynamics and then revert the process.
sentences.zh: 本文通过考虑流行的\emph{预测器-校正器}方案的一个版本来解决该问题：运行前向过程后，我们首先通过非精确Langevin动力学估计最终分布，然后逆转该过程。

sentences.en: Our key technical contribution is to provide convergence guarantees which require to run the forward process \emph{only for a fixed finite time} $T_1$.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键技术贡献是提供收敛保证，该保证要求\emph{仅}以固定的有限时间 $T_1$ 运行前向过程。

sentences.en: Our bounds exhibit a mild logarithmic dependence on the input dimension and the subgaussian norm of the target distribution, have minimal assumptions on the data, and require only to control the $L^2$ loss on the score approximation, which is the quantity minimized in practice.
sentences.zh: 我们的界对输入维度和目标分布的次高斯范数表现出温和的对数依赖，对数据具有极小的假设，并且仅需要控制分数近似的 $L^2$ 损失，而这是实践中被最小化的量。

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: Improved Dimension Dependence for Bandit Convex Optimization with Gradient Variations
title_zh: 带梯度变化的Bandit凸优化的改进维度依赖

sentences.en: Gradient-variation online learning has drawn increasing attention due to its deep connections to game theory, optimization, etc.
sentences.zh: 梯度变化在线学习因其与博弈论、优化等的深层联系而日益受到关注。

sentences.en: It has been studied extensively in the full-information setting, but is underexplored with bandit feedback.
sentences.zh: 它已在全信息设置中被广泛研究，但在bandit反馈下探索不足。

sentences.en: In this work, we focus on gradient variation in Bandit Convex Optimization (BCO) with two-point feedback.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们聚焦于带两点反馈的Bandit凸优化（BCO）中的梯度变化。

sentences.en: By proposing a refined analysis on the *non-consecutive* gradient variation, a fundamental quantity in gradient variation with bandits, we improve the dimension dependence for both convex and strongly convex functions compared with the best known results (Chiang et al., 2013).
sentences.zh: 通过提出对*非连续*梯度变化（bandit下梯度变化中的一个基本量）的精化分析，与已知最优结果（Chiang等人，2013）相比，我们改进了凸函数和强凸函数二者的维度依赖。

sentences.en: Our improved analysis for the non-consecutive gradient variation also implies other favorable problem-dependent guarantees, such as gradient-variance and small-loss regrets.
sentences.zh: 我们对非连续梯度变化的改进分析还蕴含了其他有利的问题依赖保证，如梯度方差和小损失遗憾。

sentences.en: Beyond the two-point setup, we demonstrate the versatility of our technique by achieving the *first* gradient-variation bound for one-point bandit linear optimization over hyper-rectangular domains.
sentences.zh: 超越两点设置，我们通过在超矩形域上实现*首次*单点bandit线性优化的梯度变化界，展示了我们技术的通用性。

sentences.en: Finally, we validate the effectiveness of our results in more challenging tasks such as dynamic/universal regret minimization and bandit games, establishing the *first* gradient-variation dynamic and universal regret bounds for two-point BCO and fast convergence rates in bandit games.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在更具挑战性的任务（如动态/通用遗憾最小化和bandit博弈）中验证了我们结果的有效性，为两点BCO建立了*首次*梯度变化动态和通用遗憾界，并在bandit博弈中实现了快速收敛速率。

title_en: Improved Distribution Estimation in $\ell_\infty$
title_zh: $\ell_\infty$ 中改进的分布估计

sentences.en: We present improved bounds for estimating discrete probability distributions under the $\ell_{\infty}$ norm.
sentences.zh: 我们在 $\ell_\infty$ 范数下提出了估计离散概率分布的改进界。

sentences.en: These include minimax bounds in expectation and high-probability tail bounds.
sentences.zh: 这些包括期望方面的极小极大界和高概率尾界。

sentences.en: We resolve some of the open questions posed in Kontorovich and Painsky (JMLR, 2025) --- including a fully empirical version of the tightest risk bound they presented and identifying the form of the worst-case extremal distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们解决了Kontorovich和Painsky（JMLR，2025）提出的一些开放问题——包括他们所呈现的最紧风险界的一个完全经验版本，以及识别最坏情形极值分布的形式。

sentences.en: Encouraging empirical results are reported as well.
sentences.zh: 我们还报告了令人鼓舞的实证结果。

authors.name: Yonatan Livshitz
authors.institution: Ben Gurion University of the Negev

title_en: Improved Dynamic Algorithm for Non-monotone Submodular Maximization under Cardinality Constraint
title_zh: 基数约束下非单调子模最大化的改进动态算法

sentences.en: We study fully dynamic non-monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint $k$.
sentences.zh: 我们研究基数约束 $k$ 下的全动态非单调子模最大化。

sentences.en: Prior work achieved approximation guarantees of $(0.125-\epsilon)$ using $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-1}k^2)$ oracle queries per update (NeurIPS'20) and $0.171$ using $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-3}k^4)$ oracle queries per update (NeurIPS'25).
sentences.zh: 先前工作在使用每更新 $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-1}k^2)$ 次oracle查询时实现了 $(0.125-\epsilon)$ 的近似保证（NeurIPS20），并在每更新 $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-3}k^4)$ 次oracle查询时实现了 $0.171$（NeurIPS25）。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a dynamic algorithm that achieves a $0.262$-approximation with worst-case expected update time $O(\epsilon^{-3}k\log(k)\log(\epsilon^{-1}k) + \epsilon^{-2}k^2\log(k))$, where $0 < \epsilon \leq 1$ is the error parameter.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种动态算法，它以最坏情形期望更新时间 $O(\epsilon^{-3}k\log(k)\log(\epsilon^{-1}k) + \epsilon^{-2}k^2\log(k))$ 实现 $0.262$-近似，其中 $0 < \epsilon \leq 1$ 是误差参数。

sentences.en: We also develop another dynamic algorithm with update time bounded by $\mathrm{poly}(\epsilon^{-1},k)$ that achieves a $0.277$-approximation guarantee.
sentences.zh: 我们还开发了另一种更新时间以 $\mathrm{poly}(\epsilon^{-1},k)$ 为界的动态算法，它实现了 $0.277$-近似保证。

title_en: Improved Scaling Laws via Weak-to-Strong Generalization in Random Features Ridge Regression
title_zh: 通过随机特征岭回归中的弱到强泛化改进缩放定律

sentences.en: It is increasingly common in machine learning to use learned models to label data and then employ such data to train more capable models.
sentences.zh: 在机器学习中，使用学得的模型标注数据、然后利用这些数据训练更强的模型，已变得越来越常见。

sentences.en: The phenomenon of weak-to-strong generalization exemplifies the advantage of this two-stage procedure: a strong student is trained on imperfect labels obtained from a weak teacher, and yet the strong student outperforms the weak teacher.
sentences.zh: 弱到强泛化现象体现了这种两阶段过程的优势：强学生模型在不完美标签（由弱教师获得）上训练，然而强学生仍优于弱教师。

sentences.en: In this paper, we show that the potential improvement is substantial, in the sense that it affects the scaling law followed by the test error.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们表明，潜在改进是实质性的，因为它影响了测试误差所遵循的缩放定律。

sentences.en: Specifically, we consider students and teachers trained via random features ridge regression (RFRR).
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们考虑通过随机特征岭回归（RFRR）训练的学生和教师。

sentences.en: Our main technical contribution is to derive a deterministic equivalent for the excess test error of the student trained on labels obtained via the teacher.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要技术贡献是为在通过教师获得的标签上训练的学生，推导出多余测试误差的一个确定性等价形式。

sentences.en: Via this deterministic equivalent, we then identify regimes in which the scaling law of the student improves upon that of the teacher, unveiling that the improvement can be achieved both in bias-dominated and variance-dominated settings.
sentences.zh: 借助这一确定性等价形式，我们随后识别出学生的缩放定律优于教师的各种机制，揭示改进既可在偏差主导也可在方差主导的设置中实现。

sentences.en: Strikingly, the student may attain the minimax optimal rate regardless of the scaling law of the teacher---in fact, when the test error of the teacher does not even decay with the sample size.
sentences.zh: 引人注目的是，学生可以达到极小极大最优速率，而无论教师的缩放定律如何——实际上，即使教师的测试误差甚至不随样本量衰减时也是如此。

authors.name: Diyuan Wu
authors.institution: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)

title_en: Improved Stochastic Optimization of LogSumExp
title_zh: LogSumExp的改进随机优化

sentences.en: The LogSumExp function, dual to the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, plays a central role in many important optimization problems, including entropy-regularized optimal transport (OT) and distributionally robust optimization (DRO).
sentences.zh: LogSumExp函数作为Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度的对偶，在许多重要的优化问题中发挥着核心作用，包括熵正则化最优传输（OT）和分布鲁棒优化（DRO）。

sentences.en: In practice, when the number of exponential terms inside the logarithm is large or infinite, optimization becomes challenging since computing the gradient requires differentiating every term.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，当对数内部指数项的数量很大或无限时，优化变得具有挑战性，因为计算梯度需要对每一项求导。

sentences.en: We propose a novel convexity- and smoothness-preserving approximation to LogSumExp that can be efficiently optimized using stochastic gradient methods.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的保持凸性和光滑性的LogSumExp近似，可以使用随机梯度方法高效优化。

sentences.en: This approximation is rooted in a sound modification of the KL divergence in the dual, resulting in a new $f$-divergence called the *Safe KL divergence*.
sentences.zh: 这一近似植根于对偶中KL散度的一种合理修改，产生了一个新的 $f$-散度，称为*安全KL散度*。

sentences.en: Our experiments and theoretical analysis of the LogSumExp-based stochastic optimization, arising in DRO and continuous OT, demonstrate the advantages of our approach over existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们在DRO和连续OT中出现的、基于LogSumExp的随机优化的实验和理论分析，证明了我们的方法相对于现有基线的优势。

authors.name: Alexey Kroshnin
authors.institution: Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics

authors.name: Pavel Dvurechenskii
authors.institution: WIAS im Forschungsverbund Berlin e. V.

title_en: Improving Adversarial Robustness of Attribution via Implicit Regularization
title_zh: 通过隐式正则化改进归因的对抗鲁棒性

sentences.en: The adversarial robustness of attributions is a fundamental requirement for reliable explainability in deep learning, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive explicit regularization.
sentences.zh: 归因的对抗鲁棒性是深度学习中可靠可解释性的一个基本要求，然而现有方法通常依赖计算昂贵的显式正则化。

sentences.en: In this work, we show that attribution robustness can arise implicitly from the learning dynamics of standard stochastic gradient descent.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们表明归因鲁棒性可以从标准随机梯度下降的学习动力学中隐式地涌现。

sentences.en: We theoretically motivate this effect through connections between parameter-space and input-space curvature, and validate it across architectures, datasets, and attribution methods, with negligible computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 我们通过参数空间与输入空间曲率之间的联系在理论上论证了这一效应，并以可忽略的计算开销在架构、数据集和归因方法上对其进行了验证。

sentences.en: In contrast, we prove that such robustness gains often does not transfer to attention-based attribution under softmax normalization, due to inherent entropy constraints, and we validate this limitation experimentally.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们证明此类鲁棒性增益在softmax归一化下往往不能迁移到基于注意力的归因，这是由固有的熵约束所致，并且我们在实验上验证了这一局限。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that replacing softmax attention with kernel-based attention restores the robustness gains in transformer models.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明用基于核的注意力替代softmax注意力可以恢复transformer模型中的鲁棒性增益。

sentences.en: Our results highlight learning dynamics as a principled and practical mechanism for robust explainability, and reveal fundamental limitations of attention-based attribution under normalization.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果凸显了学习动力学作为鲁棒可解释性的一种有原则且实用的机制，并揭示了基于注意力的归因在归一化下的根本局限。

title_en: Improving Backward Conformal Prediction via Non-Conformity Score Transformation
title_zh: 通过非一致性分数变换改进后向共形预测

sentences.en: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides a statistical framework for uncertainty quantification that constructs prediction sets with coverage guarantees.
sentences.zh: 共形预测（CP）提供了一个用于不确定性量化的统计框架，它构建具有覆盖保证的预测集。

sentences.en: While CP yields uncontrolled prediction set sizes, Backward Conformal Prediction (BCP) inverts this paradigm by enforcing a predefined upper bound on set size and estimating the resulting coverage guarantee.
sentences.zh: 虽然CP会产生不受控制的预测集大小，后向共形预测（BCP）通过强制对集大小施加预定义上界并估计所得的覆盖保证，反转了这一范式。

sentences.en: However, the looseness induced by Markov's inequality within the BCP framework causes a significant gap between the estimated coverage bound and the empirical coverage.
sentences.zh: 然而，BCP框架内由Markov不等式引入的宽松性，导致估计的覆盖界与经验覆盖之间存在显著差距。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce ST-BCP, a novel method that introduces a data-dependent transformation of nonconformity scores to narrow the coverage gap.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了ST-BCP，一种新颖的方法，它引入对非一致性分数的数据依赖变换以缩小覆盖差距。

sentences.en: In particular, we develop a computable transformation and prove that it outperforms the baseline identity transformation.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们开发了一种可计算的变换，并证明它优于基线恒等变换。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, reducing the average coverage gap from 4.20\% to 1.12\% on common benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性，在常见基准上将平均覆盖差距从4.20\%降至1.12\%。

title_en: Improving Classifier-Free Guidance of Flow Matching via Manifold Projection
title_zh: 通过流形投影改进流匹配的无分类器引导

sentences.en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a widely used technique for controllable generation in diffusion and flow-based models.
sentences.zh: 无分类器引导（CFG）是一种广泛用于扩散和基于流模型的受控生成的技术。

sentences.en: Despite its empirical success, CFG relies on a heuristic linear extrapolation that is often sensitive to the guidance scale.
sentences.zh: 尽管在实证上取得成功，CFG依赖一种启发式的线性外推，它往往对引导尺度敏感。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide a principled interpretation of CFG through the lens of optimization.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过优化的视角为CFG提供了一种有原则的解释。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that the velocity field in flow matching corresponds to the gradient of a sequence of smoothed distance functions, which guides latent variables toward the scaled target image set.
sentences.zh: 我们证明流匹配中的速度场对应一系列平滑距离函数的梯度，它引导潜在变量朝向缩放后的目标图像集。

sentences.en: This perspective reveals that the standard CFG formulation is an approximation of this gradient, where the prediction gap, the discrepancy between conditional and unconditional outputs, governs guidance sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 这一视角揭示，标准CFG公式是该梯度的一个近似，其中预测差距（条件与无条件输出之间的差异）支配着引导敏感性。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we reformulate the CFG sampling as a homotopy optimization with a manifold constraint.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们将CFG采样重构为带流形约束的同伦优化。

sentences.en: This formulation necessitates a manifold projection step, which we implement via an incremental gradient descent scheme during sampling.
sentences.zh: 这一公式需要一步流形投影，我们在采样期间通过增量梯度下降方案实现它。

sentences.en: To improve computational efficiency and stability, we further enhance this iterative process with Anderson Acceleration without requiring additional model evaluations.
sentences.zh: 为提高计算效率和稳定性，我们进一步用Anderson加速增强这一迭代过程，而无需额外的模型评估。

sentences.en: Our proposed methods are training-free and consistently refine generation fidelity, prompt alignment, and robustness to the guidance scale.
sentences.zh: 我们提出的方法是免训练的，并持续精化生成保真度、提示对齐和对引导尺度的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: We validate their effectiveness across diverse benchmarks, demonstrating significant improvements on large-scale models such as  DiT-XL-2-256, Flux, and Stable Diffusion 3.5. Code is available at https://github.com/LeonSuZhengYi/CFG-MP.
sentences.zh: 我们在多样基准上验证了它们的有效性，在DiT-XL-2-256、Flux和Stable Diffusion 3.5等大规模模型上展示了显著改进。代码可在 https://github.com/LeonSuZhengYi/CFG-MP 获取。
