title_en: Improving CLIP Adaptation by Breaking Tail Alignment for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning
title_zh: 通过打破尾部对齐改进CLIP适配用于无源跨域少样本学习

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization, but their performance significantly degrades in cross-domain scenarios with scarce target-domain training data (Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning, CDFSL).
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）如CLIP展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但其性能在目标域训练数据稀缺的跨域场景（跨域少样本学习，CDFSL）中显著下降。

sentences.en: In this paper, we focus on the target-domain few-shot finetuning in the CLIP-based CDFSL task.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们聚焦于基于CLIP的CDFSL任务中的目标域少样本微调。

sentences.en: Prevailing finetuning paradigms uniformly align all image patch tokens with their corresponding textual embeddings.
sentences.zh: 主流的微调范式统一地将所有图像patch词元与其对应的文本嵌入对齐。

sentences.en: However, we find a counterintuitive phenomenon: actively pushing away certain low-similarity image tokens, termed “tail tokens”, from their textual embeddings consistently improves target-domain performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们发现了一个反直觉的现象：主动将某些低相似度图像词元（称为“尾词元”）推离其文本嵌入，能持续改进目标域性能。

sentences.en: We delve into this phenomenon and provide a novel interpretation: under great domain shifts and scarce training data, the model can hardly extract semantic information from visual inputs; therefore, the common belief of alignment is valid only for tokens already containing sufficient semantic information; for tail tokens, forcing the alignment would lead to excessive overfitting to the scarce training, while breaking the alignment is more useful.
sentences.zh: 我们深入研究了这一现象，并提供了一种新颖的解释：在巨大的域偏移和稀缺的训练数据下，模型几乎无法从视觉输入中提取语义信息；因此，对齐的常见信念仅对已经包含足够语义信息的词元成立；对于尾词元，强制对齐会导致对稀缺训练的过度拟合，而打破对齐则更有用。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose Adaptive Tail-Head Alignment (ATHA), a novel fine-tuning strategy for CLIP that transforms the conventional uniform alignment paradigm to an adaptive alignment paradigm, with both alignment strengthening and weakening.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出了自适应尾-头对齐（ATHA），一种新颖的CLIP微调策略，它将传统的统一对齐范式转变为自适应对齐范式，同时包含对齐增强和对齐减弱。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on four challenging CDFSL benchmarks validate our state-of-the-art performance.
sentences.zh: 在四个具有挑战性的CDFSL基准上的大量实验验证了我们的最先进性能。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/shuaiyi308/ATHA.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/shuaiyi308/ATHA 获取。

title_en: Improving Diffusion Planners by Self-Supervised Action Gating with Energies
title_zh: 通过带能量的自监督动作门控改进扩散规划器

sentences.en: Diffusion planners are a strong approach for offline reinforcement learning, but they can fail when value-guided selection favours trajectories that score well yet are locally inconsistent with the environment dynamics, resulting in brittle execution.
sentences.zh: 扩散规划器是离线强化学习的一种强方法，但当价值引导的选择偏向于得分高却与环境动力学局部不一致的轨迹时，它们可能会失败，导致脆弱的执行。

sentences.en: We propose Self-supervised Action Gating with Energies (SAGE), an inference-time re-ranking method that penalises dynamically inconsistent plans using a latent consistency signal.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了带能量的自监督动作门控（SAGE），一种推断时重排序方法，它使用潜在一致性信号惩罚动态不一致的计划。

sentences.en: SAGE trains a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) encoder on offline state sequences and an action-conditioned latent predictor for short horizon transitions.
sentences.zh: SAGE在离线状态序列上训练联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）编码器，并为短时域转换训练一个动作条件化潜在预测器。

sentences.en: At test time, SAGE assigns each sampled candidate an energy given by its latent prediction error and combines this feasibility score with value estimates to select actions.
sentences.zh: 在测试时，SAGE为每个采样的候选者分配一个由其潜在预测误差给出的能量，并将这一可行性分数与价值估计相结合来选择动作。

sentences.en: SAGE can integrates into existing diffusion planning pipelines that can sample trajectories and select actions via value scoring; it requires no environment rollouts and no policy re-training.
sentences.zh: SAGE可以集成到现有的扩散规划流水线中，后者通过价值评分采样轨迹并选择动作；它不需要环境展开，也不需要策略重训练。

sentences.en: Across locomotion, navigation, and manipulation benchmarks, SAGE improves the performance and robustness of diffusion planners.
sentences.zh: 在运动、导航和操作基准上，SAGE改进了扩散规划器的性能和鲁棒性。

title_en: Improving Explicit Dynamic Gaussian Splatting Optimization via Update Mixture
title_zh: 通过更新混合改进显式动态高斯泼溅优化

sentences.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time, high-fidelity view synthesis via explicit scene representations and has recently been extended to dynamic scene modeling.
sentences.zh: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）通过显式场景表示实现了实时、高保真的视图合成，并已被近期扩展到动态场景建模。

sentences.en: Despite their excellent rendering quality and interpretability, we find that explicit Dynamic GS often exhibits generalization degradation in scenes with large motion.
sentences.zh: 尽管渲染质量出色且可解释性强，我们发现在具有大幅度运动的场景中，显式动态GS往往表现出泛化退化。

sentences.en: Motivated by generalization behavior in deep neural optimization and the characteristics of Gaussian primitive optimization, we propose an update mixture strategy.
sentences.zh: 受深度神经优化中的泛化行为和高斯基元优化特性的启发，我们提出了一种更新混合策略。

sentences.en: This work focuses on two representative open-source explicit Dynamic GS pipelines and our approach consists of three components: (i) a space–time dependent Strictly Sparse Update with additional regularization to stabilize adaptive updates; (ii) a constant-corrected adaptive algorithm that alleviates over-scaling of primitive gradients and yields a stable mixture of adaptive and non-adaptive steps; and (iii) attributes mixing via Stochastic Attribute Averaging to mitigate frame-preference under motion disturbances.
sentences.zh: 这项工作聚焦于两个有代表性的开源显式动态GS流水线，我们的方法包含三个组件：（i）一个时空依赖的严格稀疏更新，并附加强正则化以稳定自适应更新；（ii）一个常数校正的自适应算法，缓解基元梯度的过度缩放，并产生自适应与非自适应步骤的稳定混合；以及（iii）通过随机属性平均进行属性混合，以缓解运动扰动下的帧偏好。

sentences.en: Experiments show consistent improvements and reduced generalization issues, highlighting the role of non-adaptive updates and the impact of frame-preference in explicit Dynamic GS optimization.
sentences.zh: 实验显示出一致的改进和泛化问题的减少，凸显了非自适应更新在显式动态GS优化中的作用以及帧偏好的影响。

title_en: Improving LLM-Based Recommenders with Conservative Generative Flow Networks
title_zh: 用保守生成流网络改进基于LLM的推荐系统

sentences.en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) have recently been used to improve diversity and mitigate popularity bias in LLM-based recommender systems, yet most objectives are developed under online-style assumptions.
sentences.zh: 生成流网络（GFlowNets）近期被用于改善基于LLM的推荐系统中的多样性和缓解流行度偏差，然而大多数目标是在在线式假设下开发的。

sentences.en: In offline LLM-based recommendation, learning is constrained to a fixed logged dataset, yielding partial support over token transitions on the dataset-induced token-prefix DAG.
sentences.zh: 在离线基于LLM的推荐中，学习被限制在一个固定的已记录数据集上，这在数据集诱导的词元前缀DAG上产生了对词元转换的部分支持。

sentences.en: Naively applying Sub-Trajectory Balance (SubTB) becomes non-identifiable and can arbitrarily allocate probability mass to unsupported regions.
sentences.zh: 天真地应用子轨迹平衡（SubTB）变得不可识别，并可能将概率质量任意分配到不受支持的区域。

sentences.en: We formalize this failure and identify three sources of non-identifiability that induce distributional shift between the dataset-implied policy and the learned policy: (i) flow overestimation, (ii) forward mass leakage, and (iii) backward compensation.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一失败形式化，并识别出诱导数据集隐含策略与学习策略之间分布漂移的三个不可识别性来源：（i）流的高估，（ii）前向质量泄漏，以及（iii）后向补偿。

sentences.en: To address it, we propose CFlower, which introduces a conservative SubTB objective that explicitly penalizes unsupported forward flow mass, and combines it with dataset-constrained policy learning with on-policy sampling on the dataset-induced DAG for efficient training under offline constraints.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出了CFlower，它引入了一个保守的SubTB目标，显式地惩罚不受支持的前向流质量，并将其与数据集约束的策略学习相结合，在数据集诱导的DAG上进行在策略采样，以在离线约束下实现高效训练。

sentences.en: Experiments on three Amazon recommendation datasets show that CFlower improves distributional matching and delivers a stronger accuracy--exposure trade-off than prior GFlowNet and SFT baselines, while serving as a more reliable reference policy for downstream RL fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在三个Amazon推荐数据集上的实验表明，CFlower改善了分布匹配，并提供了比先前GFlowNet和SFT基线更强的准确率-曝光权衡，同时作为下游RL微调更可靠的参考策略。

title_en: Improving ML Attacks on LWE with Data Repetition and Stepwise Regression
title_zh: 用数据重复和逐步回归改进对LWE的ML攻击

sentences.en: ML attacks on Learning with Errors (LWE) with binary or small secrets only succeed on LWE settings with very simple secrets.
sentences.zh: 对带二值或小秘密的学习误差问题（LWE）的ML攻击仅在具有非常简单的秘密的LWE设置中成功。

sentences.en: For example, they can recover secrets with up to three non-zero bits when models are trained on not-reduced LWE data, and three non-zero bits in the ''cruel region'' [9] when BKZ pre-processing is applied.
sentences.zh: 例如，当模型在未约简的LWE数据上训练时，它们能恢复最多三个非零比特的秘密，而在应用BKZ预处理时，能在“恶劣区域”【9】中恢复三个非零比特。

sentences.en: We show that larger training sets and the use of repeated examples in the training data allow the recovery of denser secrets.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，更大的训练集以及训练数据中重复示例的使用允许恢复更稠密的秘密。

sentences.en: We empirically observe a power-law relationship between model based attempts to recover the secrets, dataset size and repeated examples.
sentences.zh: 我们经验性地观察到模型恢复秘密的尝试次数、数据集大小和重复示例之间的幂律关系。

sentences.en: We introduce a stepwise regression technique to recover the ``cool bits'' of the secret.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一种逐步回归技术来恢复秘密的“冷比特”。

sentences.en: Overall, these techniques allow for the recovery of denser binary secrets: up to Hamming weight $70$ (and $8$ cruel bits) for dimension $256$ $\log_2 q=20$ and $75$ (and $7$ cruel bits) for dimension $512$ $\log_2 q=41$ (vs $33$ and $63$ Hamming weight and $3$ cruel bits in previous works).
sentences.zh: 总体而言，这些技术允许恢复更稠密的二值秘密：对于维度 $256$ 且 $\log_2 q=20$，最多达到Hamming权重 $70$（和 $8$ 个恶劣比特）；对于维度 $512$ 且 $\log_2 q=41$，达到 $75$（和 $7$ 个恶劣比特）（而先前工作中为 $33$ 和 $63$ Hamming权重及 $3$ 个恶劣比特）。

sentences.en: We also demonstrate our methods' effectiveness on denser ternary secrets, showing a substantial improvement over prior work.
sentences.zh: 我们还展示了我们的方法在更稠密的三元秘密上的有效性，相对于先前工作显示出大幅改进。

title_en: Improving Sampling for Masked Diffusion Models via Information Gain
title_zh: 通过信息增益改进掩码扩散模型的采样

sentences.en: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) enable flexible decoding orders, yet existing samplers remain largely greedy, selecting locally certain tokens without accounting for their downstream effects.
sentences.zh: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）支持灵活的解码顺序，然而现有的采样器在很大程度上仍是贪心的，它们选择局部确定的词元，却不考虑其下游影响。

sentences.en: We show that this myopia can increase cumulative uncertainty and lead to suboptimal generation.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这种短视会增加累积不确定性，并导致次优的生成。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose the **Info-Gain Sampler**, a training-free decoding method that uses the bidirectional structure of MDMs to balance immediate uncertainty with the information gained over remaining masked positions.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了**信息增益采样器**，一种免训练的解码方法，它利用MDM的双向结构来平衡即时不确定性与在剩余掩码位置获得的信息增益。

sentences.en: Across reasoning, coding, creative writing, and image generation tasks, Info-Gain Sampler consistently outperforms existing MDM samplers, improving average reasoning accuracy by 2.9--11.6 percentage points and achieving a 62.8% average win rate in creative writing.
sentences.zh: 在推理、编码、创意写作和图像生成任务中，信息增益采样器持续优于现有MDM采样器，将平均推理准确率提高了2.9--11.6个百分点，并在创意写作中实现了62.8%的平均胜率。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/yks23/Information-Gain-Sampler.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/yks23/Information-Gain-Sampler 获取。

title_en: Improving the Performance and Learning Stability of Parallelizable RNNs Designed for Ultra-Low Power Applications
title_zh: 改进面向超低功耗应用的可并行RNN的性能与学习稳定性

sentences.en: Sequence learning is dominated by Transformers and parallelizable recurrent neural networks such as state-space models, yet learning long-term dependencies remains challenging, and state-of-the-art designs trade power consumption for performance.
sentences.zh: 序列学习由Transformer和可并行递归神经网络（如状态空间模型）主导，然而学习长期依赖仍具挑战性，最先进的设计往往以功耗换取性能。

sentences.en: The Bistable Memory Recurrent Unit (BMRU) was introduced to enable hardware–software co-design of ultra-low power RNNs: quantized states with hysteresis provide persistent memory while mapping directly to analog primitives.
sentences.zh: 双稳态记忆递归单元（BMRU）被引入以支持超低功耗RNN的软硬件协同设计：带滞回的量化状态在直接映射到模拟原语的同时提供了持久记忆。

sentences.en: However, BMRU performance lags behind parallelizable RNNs on complex sequential tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，在复杂的序列任务上，BMRU的性能落后于可并行RNN。

sentences.en: In this paper, we identify gradient blocking during state updates as a key limitation and propose a cumulative update formulation that restores gradient flow while preserving persistent memory, creating skip-connections through time.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们识别出状态更新期间的梯度阻断是一个关键局限，并提出一种累积更新公式，它在保持持久记忆的同时恢复梯度流，从而创建跨时间的跳跃连接。

sentences.en: This leads to the Cumulative Memory Recurrent Unit (CMRU) and its relaxed variant, the $\alpha$CMRU.
sentences.zh: 这导致了累积记忆递归单元（CMRU）及其松弛变体 $\alpha$CMRU。

sentences.en: Experiments show that the cumulative formulation dramatically improves convergence stability and reduces initialization sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，累积公式显著改善了收敛稳定性并降低了初始化敏感性。

sentences.en: The CMRU and $\alpha$CMRU match the performance of Linear Recurrent Units (LRUs) and minimal Gated Recurrent Units (minGRUs) on standard benchmarks at small model sizes, while the CMRU retains quantized states, persistent memory, and noise-resilient dynamics essential for analog implementation.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准的小模型规模下，CMRU和 $\alpha$CMRU 匹配了线性递归单元（LRU）和最小门控递归单元（minGRU）的性能，同时CMRU保留了模拟实现所必需的量化状态、持久记忆和抗噪动力学。

title_en: Improving the Robustness-Utility Trade-off in Decentralized Learning over Sparse Networks
title_zh: 改进稀疏网络上分散学习中的鲁棒性-效用权衡

sentences.en: Resilience against Byzantine attackers and faster convergence on sparse networks are critical for decentralized optimization, yet existing methods fail to achieve both simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 对拜占庭攻击者的韧性和在稀疏网络上更快的收敛对于分散优化至关重要，然而现有方法无法同时实现两者。

sentences.en: Existing DSGD-based Byzantine-resilient methods suffer from high transient complexity of $\mathcal{O}\left((1-\lambda)^{-6}\right)$, where $1-\lambda$ denotes the spectral gap of the network.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于DSGD的拜占庭鲁棒方法承受着高瞬态复杂度 $\mathcal{O}\left((1-\lambda)^{-6}\right)$，其中 $1-\lambda$ 表示网络的谱间隙。

sentences.en: While bias-correction methods such as Exact Diffusion can improve topology dependence, directly combining them with robust aggregators can lead to error accumulation.
sentences.zh: 虽然偏差校正方法（如Exact Diffusion）可以改善拓扑依赖，但将它们与鲁棒聚合器直接结合可能导致误差累积。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we introduce the scaled dual ascent (SDA) within the augmented Lagrangian framework for decentralized optimization, which mitigates error accumulation by scaling the dual update steps.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们在用于分散优化的增广Lagrangian框架内引入了缩放对偶上升（SDA），它通过缩放对偶更新步来缓解误差累积。

sentences.en: Based on this, we propose BRED, which integrates Byzantine-robust Exact Diffusion with the SDA framework.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出了BRED，它将拜占庭鲁棒的Exact Diffusion与SDA框架相结合。

sentences.en: We prove that BRED attains linear speedup, and achieves transient complexity of $\mathcal{O}\left((1-\lambda)^{-2}\right)$ when the Byzantine fraction $\delta$ is small.
sentences.zh: 我们证明BRED实现了线性加速，并且在拜占庭比例 $\delta$ 较小时达到瞬态复杂度 $\mathcal{O}\left((1-\lambda)^{-2}\right)$。

sentences.en: We further propose the momentum variant BRED-M, which reduces the Byzantine-affected transient complexity from $\mathcal{O}\left(\delta^2(1-\lambda)^{-6}\right)$ to $\mathcal{O}\left(\delta^2(1-\lambda)^{-4}\right)$.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出动量变体BRED-M，它将拜占庭影响的瞬态复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}\left(\delta^2(1-\lambda)^{-6}\right)$ 降低到 $\mathcal{O}\left(\delta^2(1-\lambda)^{-4}\right)$。

sentences.en: Empirical results on benchmark datasets demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed methods across diverse network topologies.
sentences.zh: 在基准数据集上的实证结果证明了所提方法在多样网络拓扑上的有效性。

title_en: Improving the Sensitivity of Backdoor Detectors via Class Subspace Orthogonalization
title_zh: 通过类子空间正交化改进后门检测器的灵敏度

sentences.en: Most post-training backdoor detection methods rely on attacked models exhibiting extreme outlier detection statistics for the target class of an attack, compared to non-target classes.
sentences.zh: 大多数训练后后门检测方法依赖于作为攻击目标类的被攻击模型相对于非目标类表现出极端的离群检测统计量。

sentences.en: However, these approaches may fail: (1) when some (non-target) classes are easily discriminable from all others, in which case they may _naturally_ achieve extreme detection statistics (e.g., decision confidence); and (2) when the backdoor is subtle, i.e., with its features weak relative to intrinsic class-discriminative features.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法可能会失败：（1）当某些（非目标）类容易与所有其他类区分时，此时它们可能_自然地_达到极端的检测统计量（如决策置信度）；（2）当后门很微妙时，即其特征相对于内蕴的类判别特征较弱。

sentences.en: A key observation is that the backdoor target class has contributions to its detection statistic from both the backdoor trigger _and_ from its intrinsic features, whereas non-target classes _only_ have contributions from their intrinsic features.
sentences.zh: 一个关键的观察是，后门目标类对其检测统计量的贡献既来自后门触发器_也_来自其内蕴特征，而非目标类_仅_有来自其内蕴特征的贡献。

sentences.en: To achieve more sensitive detectors, we thus propose to _suppress_ intrinsic features while optimizing the detection statistic for a given class.
sentences.zh: 为了实现更灵敏的检测器，我们因此提出在给定类的检测统计量优化中_抑制_内蕴特征。

sentences.en: For non-target classes, such suppression will drastically reduce the achievable statistic, whereas for the target class the (significant) contribution from the backdoor trigger remains.
sentences.zh: 对于非目标类，这种抑制将大幅降低可达统计量，而对于目标类，来自后门触发器的（显著）贡献仍然存在。

sentences.en: In practice, we formulate a constrained optimization problem, leveraging a small set of clean examples from a given class, and optimizing the detection statistic while orthogonalizing with respect to the class's intrinsic features.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，我们形式化了一个约束优化问题，利用来自给定类的一小组干净示例，在与类的内蕴特征正交化的同时优化检测统计量。

sentences.en: We dub this approach ''class subspace orthogonalization'' (CSO).
sentences.zh: 我们将这种方法称为“类子空间正交化”（CSO）。

sentences.en: CSO can be ''plug-and-play'' applied to a wide variety of existing detectors.
sentences.zh: CSO可以“即插即用”地应用于各种现有检测器。

sentences.en: We demonstrate its effectiveness in improving several well-known detectors, comparing with a variety of baseline detectors, against a variety of attacks, on the CIFAR-10, GTSRB, and TinyImageNet domains.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了它在改善多个知名检测器方面的有效性，在CIFAR-10、GTSRB和TinyImageNet域上与各种基线检测器对比、对各种攻击进行评估。

sentences.en: Moreover, to make the detection problem even more challenging, we also evaluate against a novel mixed clean/dirty-label poisoning attack that is more surgical and harder to detect than traditional dirty-label attacks.
sentences.zh: 此外，为让检测问题更具挑战性，我们还评估了一种新颖的混合干净/脏标签投毒攻击，它比传统脏标签攻击更具外科手术性且更难检测。

sentences.en: Finally, we evaluate CSO against an adaptive attack designed to defeat it, with promising detection results.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们针对一种旨在击败CSO的自适应攻击评估CSO，取得了有前景的检测结果。

title_en: Improving Topic Modeling by Distilling Soft Labels from Language Models
title_zh: 通过从语言模型蒸馏软标签改进主题建模

sentences.en: Traditional neural topic models are typically optimized by reconstructing the document's Bag-of-Words (BoW) representations, overlooking contextual information and struggling with data sparsity.
sentences.zh: 传统的神经主题模型通常通过重构文档的词袋（BoW）表示来优化，忽略了上下文信息，并难以应对数据稀疏性。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a novel topic model training framework by Distilling Soft Labels (DSL) from Language Models (LMs).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们介绍了一种新颖的主题模型训练框架，即蒸馏软标签（DSL），它从语言模型（LM）蒸馏标签。

sentences.en: To construct the contextually enriched reconstruction signals, we project the next token probabilities, conditioned on a specialized prompt, onto a pre-defined vocabulary, and train the topic models to reconstruct the soft labels using the LM hidden states.
sentences.zh: 为构建上下文增强的重构信号，我们将以专用提示为条件的下一个词元概率投影到预定义词汇表上，并使用LM隐状态训练主题模型重构软标签。

sentences.en: This produces higher-quality topics that are more closely aligned with the underlying thematic structure of the corpus.
sentences.zh: 这产生了更高质量的主题，与语料库的潜在主题结构更紧密地对齐。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSL achieves substantial improvements in topic coherence and assignment accuracy over existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，DSL在主题一致性和分配准确率方面相较现有基线取得了实质性改进。

sentences.en: Additionally, we also introduce a retrieval-based metric, which shows that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods in identifying semantically similar documents, highlighting its effectiveness for retrieval-oriented applications.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还引入了一个基于检索的指标，它表明我们的方法在识别语义相似文档方面显著优于现有方法，凸显了其对检索导向应用的有效性。

title_en: Improving Visual Token Reduction via Rectifying Distortions for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
title_zh: 通过矫正扭曲改进视觉词元缩减以实现高效多模态LLM推断

sentences.en: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in vision-language tasks, yet the quadratic computational complexity arising from the vast number of visual tokens incurs significant memory and latency bottlenecks.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的最新进展在视觉-语言任务中取得了显著成功，然而由海量视觉词元引起的二次计算复杂度带来了显著的内存和延迟瓶颈。

sentences.en: While visual token reduction (VTR) strategies have been explored to mitigate this burden, existing methods overlook the positional and attentional consistency between the full and reduced sequences, resulting in a distorted representation.
sentences.zh: 尽管已探索视觉词元缩减（VTR）策略以缓解这一负担，现有方法忽视了完整序列与缩减序列之间的位置和注意力一致性，从而导致表示扭曲。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose RESTORE, a novel VTR framework that rectifies the positional and attentional distortions while maintaining efficiency.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了RESTORE，一种新颖的VTR框架，它在保持效率的同时矫正位置和注意力扭曲。

sentences.en: Specifically, we present a simple yet effective calibration method that restores lost visual attention by augmenting attention weights based on relative distances.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们提出了一种简单而有效的校准方法，通过基于相对距离增强注意力权重来恢复丢失的视觉注意力。

sentences.en: We also introduce a distinctive anchor selection for token merging to mitigate information loss during feature averaging.
sentences.zh: 我们还为词元合并引入了一种独特的锚点选择，以缓解特征平均过程中的信息丢失。

sentences.en: Experimental results on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently improves the accuracy of various reduction methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance while maintaining computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的实验结果表明，我们的方法持续改进各种缩减方法的准确率，在保持计算效率的同时实现了最先进的性能。

title_en: Improving Zero-Shot Offline RL via Behavioral Task Sampling
title_zh: 通过行为任务采样改进零样本离线RL

sentences.en: Offline zero-shot reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn agents that optimize unseen reward functions without additional environment interaction.
sentences.zh: 离线零样本强化学习（RL）旨在学习能优化未见奖励函数而无需额外环境交互的智能体。

sentences.en: The standard approach to this problem trains task-conditioned policies by sampling task vectors that define linear reward functions over learned state representations.
sentences.zh: 解决这一问题的标准方法是在学得的状态表示上，通过采样定义线性奖励函数的任务向量来训练任务条件化策略。

sentences.en: In most existing algorithms, these task vectors are randomly sampled, implicitly assuming this adequately captures the structure of the task space.
sentences.zh: 在大多数现有算法中，这些任务向量是随机采样的，隐式假设这足以捕获任务空间的结构。

sentences.en: We argue that doing so leads to suboptimal zero-shot generalization.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这样做会导致次优的零样本泛化。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose extracting task vectors directly from the offline dataset and using them to define the task distribution used for policy training.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出直接从离线数据集中提取任务向量，并用它们来定义用于策略训练的任务分布。

sentences.en: We introduce a simple and general reward function extraction procedure that integrates into existing offline zero-shot RL algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一种简单而通用的奖励函数提取过程，它可以集成到现有的离线零样本RL算法中。

sentences.en: Across multiple benchmark environments and baselines, our approach improves zero-shot performance by an average of 20%, highlighting the importance of principled task sampling in offline zero-shot RL.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准环境和基线上，我们的方法将零样本性能平均提高了20%，凸显了在离线零样本RL中原则性任务采样的重要性。

title_en: ImpText: A Benchmark and Tool-Augmented Framework for Implicit Text Reasoning
title_zh: ImpText：隐式文本推理的基准与工具增强框架

sentences.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional proficiency in standard text extraction, but they encounter significant challenges when confronting real-world implicit text.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在标准文本提取方面表现出非凡的熟练度，但在面对现实世界的隐式文本时遇到重大挑战。

sentences.en: Such content typically contains malicious information, intentionally concealed through physical deformation, visual camouflage, or cognitive suggestion.
sentences.zh: 此类内容通常包含恶意信息，它通过物理变形、视觉伪装或认知暗示被故意隐藏。

sentences.en: These concealment techniques circumvent content moderation systems and pose severe risks to user safety.
sentences.zh: 这些隐藏技术规避内容审核系统，并对用户安全构成严重风险。

sentences.en: To bridge the research gap in text recognition under real-world adversarial scenarios, we define the task of Implicit Text Reasoning and introduce ImpText-Bench, a meticulously constructed benchmark.
sentences.zh: 为弥合现实世界对抗场景下文本识别的研究空白，我们定义了隐式文本推理任务，并引入了ImpText-Bench，一个精心构建的基准。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on this benchmark reveal significant vulnerability in current systems; even advanced proprietary models achieve a maximum Text Match Score of only 35.79\%.
sentences.zh: 在该基准上进行的大量评估揭示了当前系统的显著脆弱性；即便是先进专有模型，其文本匹配分数也仅达到最高35.79\%。

sentences.en: In response, we propose ImpText-Reader, a tool-augmented framework.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，我们提出了ImpText-Reader，一个工具增强框架。

sentences.en: It employs a three-stage training strategy utilizing capability-boundary data to collaboratively optimize tool selection and semantic reasoning, thereby effectively extracting hidden text.
sentences.zh: 它采用利用能力边界数据的三阶段训练策略，协同优化工具选择与语义推理，从而有效提取隐藏文本。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves SOTA performance, significantly enhancing model robustness in adversarial environments.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了SOTA性能，显著增强了模型在对抗环境中的鲁棒性。

title_en: In-Context Generation with Regional Constraints for Instructional Video Editing
title_zh: 带区域约束的上下文生成用于指令式视频编辑

sentences.en: The In-context generation paradigm has demonstrated strong power in instructional image editing for better synthesis quality.
sentences.zh: 上下文生成范式在指令式图像编辑中展现出强大能力，可获得更好的合成质量。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, shaping such in-context learning for instructional video editing is not trivial.
sentences.zh: 然而，为指令式视频编辑塑造这种上下文学习并非易事。

sentences.en: Without specifying editing regions, the results can suffer from the issue of inaccurate editing regions and the token interference between different areas.
sentences.zh: 若不指定编辑区域，结果可能遭受编辑区域不精确以及不同区域间词元干扰的问题。

sentences.en: To address these, we present ReCo, a new instructional video editing paradigm that novelly delves into **Re**gional **Co**nstraint modeling between editing and non-editing areas.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了ReCo，一种新的指令式视频编辑范式，它创新性地深入探索编辑区与非编辑区之间的**区**域**约**束建模。

sentences.en: Technically, ReCo width-wise concatenates source and target video for joint denoising.
sentences.zh: 从技术上，ReCo将源视频和目标视频按宽度拼接进行联合去噪。

sentences.en: In model training, ReCo formulates regional constraints with two regularization terms, i.e., latent and attention regularization, on one-step backward denoised latents and attention maps, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在模型训练中，ReCo用两个正则项（即潜在正则和注意力正则）在一步后向去噪潜在和注意力图上分别形式化区域约束。

sentences.en: The former increases the latent discrepancy of the editing region between source and target videos while reducing that of non-editing areas, emphasizing editing area modification and alleviating unexpected content generation.
sentences.zh: 前者增加源视频与目标视频之间编辑区域的潜在差异，同时减少非编辑区域的差异，强调编辑区域修改并缓解意外内容生成。

sentences.en: The latter suppresses the attention of tokens in the editing region to the tokens in counterpart of the source video, thereby mitigating their interference during novel object generation in target video.
sentences.zh: 后者抑制编辑区域中的词元对源视频对应词元的注意力，从而在目标视频中的新物体生成期间缓解它们的干扰。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose a large-scale, high-quality video editing dataset, i.e., ReCo-Data, comprising 500K instruction-video pairs.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一个大规模、高质量的视频编辑数据集，即ReCo-Data，包含500K条指令-视频对。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments conducted on four major instruction-based video editing tasks verify the superiority of ReCo. Code is available at https://github.com/HiDream-ai/ReCo.
sentences.zh: 在四个主要基于指令的视频编辑任务上进行的大量实验验证了ReCo的优越性。代码可在 https://github.com/HiDream-ai/ReCo 获取。

title_en: In-Context Learning as Rate–Distortion Optimization
title_zh: 将上下文学习视为率失真优化

sentences.en: In-context learning (ICL) is a practical way to adapt large models, yet under strict context limits, it remains unclear how to spend scarce tokens without being misled by noisy, redundant, or conflicting demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 上下文学习（ICL）是适配大模型的一种实用方式，然而在严格的上下文限制下，尚不清楚如何在不被嘈杂、冗余或冲突的示例误导的情况下花费稀缺的词元。

sentences.en: We address this gap by targeting token-budgeted context construction: how to select and compress demonstrations so the prompt carries maximal task-relevant signal with minimal predictive distortion.
sentences.zh: 我们通过聚焦于词元预算受限的上下文构建来弥补这一空白：如何选择和压缩示例，使提示携带最大的任务相关信号和最小的预测失真。

sentences.en: We propose RDCO, a deterministic, training-free optimizer that scores demonstrations by marginal task information per token, penalizes redundancy and prefix-conditioned conflicts, and finally compacts the selected context under a bounded predictive-divergence constraint to control drift.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了RDCO，一个确定性的、免训练的优化器，它按每个词元的边际任务信息对示例评分，惩罚冗余和前缀条件化冲突，并最终在有界预测散度约束下压缩所选上下文以控制漂移。

sentences.en: Across a 10-dataset ICL suite spanning classification and structured generation, RDCO achieves the best average performance (63.26 Acc. on classification and 60.26 EM on generation), improving over the strongest classification and generation baselines by 2.20 and 2.26 points, respectively, and improving the 10-task overall average by 4.94 points under the same budget.
sentences.zh: 在一个跨分类和结构化生成的10数据集ICL套件上，RDCO实现了最佳平均性能（分类上Acc 63.26，生成上EM 60.26），相较最强的分类和生成基线分别提高2.20和2.26分，并在相同预算下将10任务整体平均值提高4.94分。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that viewing prompts as finite-capacity messages yields a principled and effective path to more reliable and token-efficient ICL.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，将提示视为有限容量消息，为更可靠和更省词元的ICL提供了一条有原则且有效的途径。

title_en: In-Context Learning Is Provably Bayesian Inference: A Generalization Theory for Meta-Learning
title_zh: 上下文学习可证明是贝叶斯推断：元学习的泛化理论

sentences.en: This paper develops a finite-sample statistical theory for in-context learning (ICL), analyzed within a meta-learning framework that accommodates mixtures of diverse task types.
sentences.zh: 本文在元学习框架内为上下文学习（ICL）发展了一种有限样本统计理论，该框架能容纳多样任务类型的混合。

sentences.en: We leverage a Bayes risk identity that separates the total ICL risk into two orthogonal components: Bayes Gap and Posterior Variance.
sentences.zh: 我们利用一个Bayes风险恒等式，将总的ICL风险分解为两个正交分量：Bayes差距与后验方差。

sentences.en: The Bayes Gap quantifies how well the trained model approximates the Bayes-optimal in-context predictor.
sentences.zh: Bayes差距量化了训练模型对Bayes最优上下文预测器的逼近程度。

sentences.en: For a uniform-attention Transformer, we derive a non-asymptotic upper bound on this gap, which explicitly clarifies the dependence on the number of pretraining prompts and their context length.
sentences.zh: 对于均匀注意力Transformer，我们推导出该差距的一个非渐近上界，它明确阐明了与预训练提示数量及上下文长度的依赖关系。

sentences.en: The Posterior Variance is a model-independent risk representing the intrinsic task uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 后验方差是一个与模型无关的风险，代表内在的任务不确定性。

sentences.en: Our key finding is that this term is determined solely by the difficulty of the true underlying task, while the uncertainty arising from the task mixture vanishes exponentially fast with only a few in-context examples.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键发现是，这一项仅由真实底层任务的难度决定，而由任务混合引起的不确定性会随仅少量上下文示例呈指数级消失。

sentences.en: Together, these results provide a unified view of ICL: the uniform-attention Transformer selects the optimal meta-algorithm during pretraining and rapidly converges to the optimal algorithm for the true task at test time.
sentences.zh: 综合这些结果，我们为ICL提供了一个统一视角：均匀注意力Transformer在预训练期间选择最优元算法，并在测试时迅速收敛到针对真实任务的最优算法。

title_en: In-Context Universal Approximation, Compositional Generalization, and Algorithm Emulation
title_zh: 上下文通用近似、组合泛化与算法仿真

sentences.en: We study in-context universal approximation and compositional generalization in frozen softmax Transformers as prompt-programmable computation.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了将冻结softmax Transformer作为提示可编程的计算模型时，其上下文通用近似与组合泛化能力。

sentences.en: We prove in-context universality via in-context emulation:  a fixed-weight Transformer emulates target computations specified by the prompt and hence approximates a broad class of continuous sequence-to-sequence functions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过上下文仿真证明上下文通用性：固定权重的Transformer仿真由提示指定的目标计算，从而近似广泛类别的连续序列到序列函数。

sentences.en: Building on this view, we establish one-pass and multi-pass composition theorems: prompts associated with simple ``subprograms'' let the same fixed Transformer execute their composition and thereby synthesize more complex programs on-the-fly.
sentences.zh: 基于这一视角，我们建立了单遍与多遍组合定理：与简单“子程序”相关联的提示，让同一个固定Transformer执行它们的组合，从而即时合成更复杂的程序。

sentences.en: These results support a principled view of prompts as programs and fixed-weight Transformers as program interpreters.
sentences.zh: 这些结果支持了“提示即程序、固定权重Transformer即程序解释器”这一有原则的视角。

sentences.en: They also provide concrete mechanisms by which GPT-style models execute and assemble algorithms in context.
sentences.zh: 它们也为GPT式模型在上下文中执行和组装算法提供了具体机制。

sentences.en: Please see arXiv for the full version.
sentences.zh: 完整版本请参见arXiv。

title_en: In-Training Defenses Against Emergent Misalignment in Language Models
title_zh: 针对语言模型涌现性错位（misalignment）的训练中防御

sentences.en: Fine‑tuning lets practitioners repurpose aligned large language models (LLMs) for new domains, yet recent work reveals emergent misalignment (EM): Even a small, domain‑specific fine‑tune can induce harmful behaviors far outside the target domain.
sentences.zh: 微调让实践者能够将已对齐的大语言模型（LLMs）重新用于新领域，然而近期工作揭示了涌现性错位（EM）：即便是小规模的、领域特定的微调，也能在目标领域之外诱发有害行为。

sentences.en: Even in the case where model weights are hidden behind a fine-tuning API, this gives attackers inadvertent access to a broadly misaligned model in a way that can be hard to detect from the fine-tuning data alone.
sentences.zh: 即便在模型权重隐藏在微调API之后的情况下，这也使攻击者能够无意中接触到一个广泛错位的模型，而且这种方式可能难以仅从微调数据中检测出来。

sentences.en: We present the first systematic study of \emph{in‑training} safeguards against EM that are practical for providers who expose fine‑tuning via an API: We evaluate whether they a) prevent broad misalignment, b) allow narrow misalignment, c) learn well on benign tasks, and d) remain coherent.
sentences.zh: 我们呈现了针对EM的\emph{训练中}防护的首次系统性研究，它对于通过API暴露微调的服务提供者是实用的：我们评估这些防护是否a）阻止广泛错位，b）允许窄域错位，c）在良性任务上学得好，d）保持连贯性。

sentences.en: We investigate five training regularization interventions: (i) KL‑divergence regularization toward a safe reference model, (ii) $\ell_2$ distance in feature space, (iii) preventive steering with an evil persona vector, (iv) interleaving training examples from a general instruct-tuning dataset and (v) inoculation prompting.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了五种训练正则化干预：（i）朝向安全参考模型的KL散度正则化，（ii）特征空间中的 $\ell_2$ 距离，（iii）用恶意角色向量进行预防性引导，（iv）交错来自通用指令调优数据集的训练示例，以及（v）接种提示。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that selecting interleaving data by the perplexity gap between aligned and misaligned models yields the best results overall.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，根据对齐与错位模型之间的困惑度差距来选择交错数据，总体上能产生最佳结果。

title_en: Incentivized Exploration with Stochastic Covariates: A Two-Stage Mechanism Design for Recommender System
title_zh: 带随机协变量的激励式探索：推荐系统的两阶段机制设计

sentences.en: Recommender systems play a crucial role in internet economies by connecting users with relevant products.
sentences.zh: 推荐系统通过将用户与相关产品连接起来，在互联网经济中发挥着关键作用。

sentences.en: However, designing effective recommender systems faces the key challenges: the exploration-exploitation tradeoff in securing incentive to explore new products against user’s self-interested preferences.
sentences.zh: 然而，设计有效的推荐系统面临关键挑战：在确保探索新产品的激励与用户自利偏好之间，存在探索-利用权衡。

sentences.en: While prior work addresses Bayesian Incentive Compatibility (BIC) in fixed-design linear bandits (Sellke & Slivkins, 2023), we tackle the challenge of stochastic user covariates sampled online.
sentences.zh: 先前工作处理了固定设计线性bandit中的Bayesian激励相容性（BIC）（Sellke & Slivkins，2023），而我们应对的是在线采样的随机用户协变量这一挑战。

sentences.en: Unlike standard black-box reductions (Mansour et al., 2020), our two-stage framework exploits the linear reward structure to achieve sublinear regret while satisfying incentive constraints.
sentences.zh: 与标准的黑盒归约（Mansour等人，2020）不同，我们的两阶段框架利用线性奖励结构，在满足激励约束的同时实现次线性遗憾。

sentences.en: To address it, we propose a two-stage algorithm that integrates incentivized exploration with any efficient plug-in offline learning algorithms.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种两阶段算法，它将激励式探索与任何高效的插件式离线学习算法相结合。

sentences.en: In the first stage, it explores products while maintaining incentive compatibility to gather optimal samples.
sentences.zh: 在第一阶段，它在保持激励相容性的同时探索产品，以收集最优样本。

sentences.en: The second stage employs inverse proportional gap sampling strategy (IPGS) integrated with any efficient learning methods to secure sublinear regret.
sentences.zh: 第二阶段采用与任何高效学习方法集成的反比例间隙采样策略（IPGS），以确保次线性遗憾。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that algorithm RCB achieves $O(\sqrt{KdT})$ regret and simultaneously satisfies incentive constraints, and discovers the tradeoff between incentive budget and regret, validating in experiments.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明算法RCB实现了 $O(\sqrt{KdT})$ 遗憾，同时满足激励约束，并发现了激励预算与遗憾之间的权衡，且在实验中得到了验证。

sentences.en: We demonstrate RCB’s strong incentive gain, sublinear regret, and robustness through a real application on personalized warfarin dosing and simulations.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个个性化warfarin剂量和模拟的真实应用，展示了RCB强大的激励增益、次线性遗憾和鲁棒性。

authors.name: Yuantong Li
authors.institution: University of California, Los Angeles & Meta

title_en: Incentivizing Truthfulness and Collaborative Fairness in Bayesian Learning
title_zh: 在Bayesian学习中激励真实性与协作公平性

sentences.en: Collaborative machine learning involves training high-quality models using datasets from a number of sources.
sentences.zh: 协作机器学习涉及使用来自多个来源的数据集来训练高质量模型。

sentences.en: To incentivize sources to share data, existing data valuation methods fairly reward each source based on its data submitted as is.
sentences.zh: 为激励来源共享数据，现有数据估值方法按每个来源按其原样提交的数据公平奖励它们。

sentences.en: However, as these methods do not verify nor incentivize data truthfulness, the sources can manipulate their data (e.g., by submitting duplicated or noisy data) to artificially increase their valuations and rewards or prevent others from benefiting.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于这些方法既不验证也不激励数据真实性，来源可以操控其数据（例如通过提交重复或带噪数据），以人为提高其估值和奖励，或阻止他人获益。

sentences.en: This paper presents the first mechanism that provably ensures (**F**) collaborative fairness and incentivizes (**T**) truthfulness at equilibrium for Bayesian models.
sentences.zh: 本文提出了首个在均衡状态下可证明地保障（**F**）协作公平性并（**T**）激励真实性的机制，适用于Bayesian模型。

sentences.en: Our mechanism combines semivalues (e.g., Shapley value), which ensure fairness, and a truthful data valuation function (DVF) based on a validation set that is unknown to the sources.
sentences.zh: 我们的机制结合了确保公平的semivalue（如Shapley值）与一个基于对来源未知的验证集的诚实数据估值函数（DVF）。

sentences.en: As semivalues are influenced by others' data, we introduce an additional condition to prove that a source can maximize its expected data values in coalitions and semivalues by submitting a dataset that captures its true knowledge.
sentences.zh: 由于semivalue受到他人数据的影响，我们引入一个附加条件来证明：一个来源能够通过在联合与semivalue中提交一个捕获其真实知识的数据集，最大化其期望数据值。

sentences.en: Additionally, we discuss the implications and suitable relaxations of (**F**) and (**T**) when the mediator has a limited budget for rewards or lacks a validation set.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们讨论了当调解者奖励预算有限或缺乏验证集时，（**F**）和（**T**）的含义与合适的放宽。

sentences.en: Our theoretical findings are validated on synthetic and real-world datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论发现已在合成和真实世界数据集上得到验证。

title_en: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Neighborhood-Conditioned Diffusion
title_zh: 通过邻域条件化扩散进行不完整多视图聚类

sentences.en: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) aims to uncover shared clustering structures from heterogeneous views with partial observations.
sentences.zh: 不完整多视图聚类（IMVC）旨在从具有部分观测的异质视图中发现共享的聚类结构。

sentences.en: Recently, existing generative IMVC methods have made significant progress in this field; however, they still remain limited in two aspects.
sentences.zh: 近期，现有的生成式IMVC方法在这一领域取得了显著进展；然而，它们在两个方面仍存在局限。

sentences.en: On the one hand, they rely on weak cross-view signals, resulting in unstable latent recovery when facing missing data.
sentences.zh: 一方面，它们依赖弱的跨视图信号，导致面对缺失数据时潜在恢复不稳定。

sentences.en: On the other hand, they overlook stable cross-view neighborhood structures, leading to weak structural constraint.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，它们忽视了稳定的跨视图邻域结构，导致结构约束薄弱。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose neighborhood-conditioned diffusion for incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC-NCD), which achieves robust latent completion.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出了面向不完整多视图聚类的邻域条件化扩散（IMVC-NCD），它实现了稳健的潜在补全。

sentences.en: Our method learns compact view-specific latent representations and constructs a unified conditioning vector by aggregating stable local neighborhood structures from available views while encoding missingness states, providing reliable guidance for diffusion-based denoising.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法学习紧凑的视图特定潜在表示，通过聚合可用视图中稳定的局部邻域结构并编码缺失状态来构建一个统一的条件向量，为基于扩散的去噪提供可靠指导。

sentences.en: With neighborhood-level conditioning, IMVC-NCD produces semantically aligned and view-consistent latent representations that are well suited for clustering, even under high missing-view ratios.
sentences.zh: 借助邻域级条件化，IMVC-NCD产生语义对齐且视图一致的潜在表示，即使在较高的缺失视图比例下也适用于聚类。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our method compared with state-of-the-art IMVC approaches.
sentences.zh: 在四个基准数据集上的大量实验证明了我们的方法相较最先进的IMVC方法的有效性和鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/zgh1115/IMVC-NCD.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zgh1115/IMVC-NCD 获取。

title_en: Inconsistency-Aware Minimization: Improving Generalization with Unlabeled Data
title_zh: 不一致感知最小化：用无标签数据改进泛化

sentences.en: Estimating the generalization gap and developing optimization methods that improve generalization are crucial for deep learning models, for both theoretical understanding and practical applications.
sentences.zh: 估计泛化差距并开发改进泛化的优化方法，对于深度学习模型在理论理解与实际应用两方面都至关重要。

sentences.en: Leveraging unlabeled data for these purposes offers significant advantages in real-world scenarios.
sentences.zh: 利用无标签数据实现这些目的，在现实场景中提供了显著优势。

sentences.en: This paper introduces a novel generalization measure, $\textit{local inconsistency}$, derived from an information-geometric perspective on the parameter space of neural networks.
sentences.zh: 本文引入了一种新颖的泛化度量——$\textit{局部不一致性}——它源自对神经网络参数空间的信息几何视角。

sentences.en: A key feature of local inconsistency is that it can be computed without explicit labels.
sentences.zh: 局部不一致性的一个关键特点是它可以在没有显式标签的情况下计算。

sentences.en: We establish theoretical underpinnings by connecting local inconsistency to the Fisher information matrix and the loss Hessian.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将局部不一致性与Fisher信息矩阵和损失Hessian联系起来，建立了理论基础。

sentences.en: Empirically, we demonstrate that local inconsistency correlates with the generalization gap.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，我们证明局部不一致性与泛化差距相关。

sentences.en: Based on these findings, we propose Inconsistency-Aware Minimization (IAM), which incorporates local inconsistency into the training objective.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，我们提出了不一致感知最小化（IAM），它将局部不一致性纳入训练目标。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that in standard supervised learning settings, IAM enhances generalization, achieving performance comparable to that of existing methods such as Sharpness-Aware Minimization.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在标准监督学习设置中，IAM增强了泛化，达到了与诸如Sharpness-Aware Minimization等现有方法相当的性能。

sentences.en: Furthermore, IAM exhibits efficacy in semi- and self-supervised learning scenarios, where the local inconsistency is computed from unlabeled data.
sentences.zh: 此外，IAM在半监督和自监督学习场景中展现有效性，其中局部不一致性从无标签数据计算。

title_en: Incorporating Importance Weighting in Optimal Transport Based Domain Alignment
title_zh: 在基于最优传输的域对齐中纳入重要性加权

sentences.en: Domain adaptation theory studies upper bounds on the target risk in order to mitigate performance loss of machine learning models due to distribution shift.
sentences.zh: 域适配理论研究目标风险的上界，以缓解机器学习模型因分布偏移造成的性能损失。

sentences.en: In this paper, we take a closer look at the optimization of one such bound based on optimal transport (OT) and propose various strategies that improve the optimization in practice.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们仔细审视了基于最优传输（OT）的这样一个界的优化，并提出了在实践中改善优化的多种策略。

sentences.en: We first introduce *gradual shift* and *probabilistic margin* assumptions to control the incomputable entanglement term that appears in the bounds.
sentences.zh: 我们首先引入*渐近偏移*和*概率性间隔*假设，以控制界中出现的不可计算的纠缠项。

sentences.en: We prove that under these assumptions, better optimization of the computable part of the bound can translate to better target accuracies.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在这些假设下，界中可计算部分的更优优化能够转化为更好的目标准确率。

sentences.en: Motivated by this fact, we tighten the bound, via importance weighting of the source (output) distribution, to obtain the *weighted* Wasserstein regularized risk ($\mathrm{W}^2\mathrm{R}^{2}$), that is often easier to minimize than the original bound.
sentences.zh: 受这一事实的启发，我们通过对源（输出）分布进行重要性加权来收紧该界，从而得到*加权*Wasserstein正则化风险（$\mathrm{W}^2\mathrm{R}^{2}$），它往往比原始界更容易最小化。

sentences.en: $\mathrm{W}^2\mathrm{R}^{2}$ is shown to be equivalent to an unbalanced OT problem, which in the limit converges to a nearest neighbor based alignment strategy.
sentences.zh: 我们表明 $\mathrm{W}^2\mathrm{R}^{2}$ 等价于一个非平衡OT问题，在极限情况下它收敛到基于最近邻的对齐策略。

sentences.en: We highlight the tradeoffs faced with such an approach and show that a suitably regularized $\mathrm{W}^2\mathrm{R}^{2}$ improves over the state of the art and is robust to multiple distribution shifts under different models, confirming, moreover, the validity of our assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我们强调了这种方法所面临的权衡，并表明一个适当正则化的 $\mathrm{W}^2\mathrm{R}^{2}$ 优于现有技术，并且在不同模型下对多种分布偏移具有鲁棒性，此外还证实了我们假设的有效性。

authors.name: Okan Koç
authors.institution: Center for Advanced Intelligence Project, RIKEN

title_en: Incremental BPE Tokenization
title_zh: 增量式BPE词元化

sentences.en: We propose a novel algorithm for incremental Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种用于增量式字节对编码（BPE）词元化的新颖算法。

sentences.en: The algorithm processes each input byte in **worst-case** $\mathcal{O}(\log^2 t)$ time, leading to an overall complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n \log^2 t)$, where $n$ is the input length and $t$ is the maximum token length.
sentences.zh: 该算法以 $\mathcal{O}(\log^2 t)$ 的最坏情形时间处理每个输入字节，从而使整体复杂度达到 $\mathcal{O}(n \log^2 t)$，其中 $n$ 是输入长度，$t$ 是最大词元长度。

sentences.en: The algorithm incrementally maintains BPE tokenization results for every prefix of the input text, implementing the standard BPE merge procedure defined by a fixed set of merge rules.
sentences.zh: 该算法为输入文本的每个前缀增量式维护BPE词元化结果，实现由一组固定合并规则定义的标准BPE合并过程。

sentences.en: This enables efficient partial tokenization in streaming settings.
sentences.zh: 这实现了流式设置中的高效部分词元化。

sentences.en: Functioning as a drop-in replacement for standard BPE, our approach achieves up to $\sim$3$\times$ speedups over Hugging Face's tokenizers, and significant latency reductions over OpenAI's tiktoken on pathological inputs.
sentences.zh: 作为标准BPE的即插即用替代品，我们的方法相较Hugging Face的tokenizers实现了高达 $\sim$3$\times$ 加速，并在病态输入上相对OpenAI的tiktoken实现了显著的延迟降低。

sentences.en: We further introduce an eager output algorithm that enables streaming output, emitting tokens as soon as token boundaries are determined during incremental tokenization.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入一种急切输出算法，它支持流式输出，在增量词元化过程中一旦确定词元边界便立即发出词元。

sentences.en: Overall, our results demonstrate that BPE tokenization can be performed incrementally with strong worst-case guarantees, while providing practical latency benefits in modern large language model pipelines.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，BPE词元化可以增量式执行并具备强最坏情形保证，同时在现代大语言模型流水线中提供实际的延迟收益。

title_en: Incremental Learning of Sparse Attention Patterns in Transformers
title_zh: Transformer中稀疏注意力模式的增量学习

sentences.en: This paper studies simple transformers trained on a high-order Markov chain, where the model must incorporate information from multiple past positions, each with different statistical importance.
sentences.zh: 本文研究在高阶Markov链上训练的简单transformer，其中模型必须整合来自多个过去位置的信息，每个位置具有不同的统计重要性。

sentences.en: We show that transformers learn the task incrementally, with each stage corresponding to learning how to copy information from a subset of positions via a sparse attention pattern.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，transformer增量式地学习该任务，每个阶段对应于通过稀疏注意力模式学习从一组位置复制信息。

sentences.en: Notably, the learning dynamics transition from a competitive phase, where all heads focus on the statistically most important positions, to a cooperative phase, where different heads specialize in different patterns.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，学习动力学从一个竞争阶段（所有注意力头聚焦于统计上最重要的位置）转变为一个协作阶段（不同注意力头专精于不同模式）。

sentences.en: We model these dynamics with simplified differential equations and prove stage-wise convergence of the resulting system.
sentences.zh: 我们用简化的微分方程对这些动力学建模，并证明所得系统的逐阶段收敛性。

sentences.en: Functionally, these stages correspond to a sequence of increasingly expressive misspecified models, with the full model class reached only at the end.
sentences.zh: 从功能上讲，这些阶段对应于一系列表达力渐增的错误指定模型，只有到最后才达到完整的模型类。

sentences.en: Overall, we give a theoretical account of how structured attention patterns and head specialization emerge in stages without an explicit curriculum, with implications for generalization in sequential tasks.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们对结构化注意力模式和注意力头专门化如何在无显式课程的情况下分阶段涌现提供了一种理论解释，这对序列任务中的泛化具有启示意义。

title_en: Incremental Transformer Neural Processes
title_zh: 增量式Transformer神经过程

sentences.en: Neural Processes (NPs), and specifically Transformer Neural Processes (TNPs), have demonstrated remarkable performance across tasks ranging from spatiotemporal forecasting to tabular data modelling.
sentences.zh: 神经过程（NP），特别是Transformer神经过程（TNP），在从时空预测到表格数据建模的任务中展现了卓越的性能。

sentences.en: However, many of these applications are inherently sequential, involving continuous data streams such as real-time sensor readings or database updates.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些应用中有许多本质上都是序列性的，涉及连续数据流，如实时传感器读数或数据库更新。

sentences.en: In such settings, models should support cheap, incremental updates rather than recomputing internal representations from scratch for every new observation—a capability existing TNP variants lack.
sentences.zh: 在此类设置中，模型应支持廉价的增量式更新，而不是为每个新观测从头重新计算内部表示——这是现有TNP变体所缺乏的能力。

sentences.en: Drawing inspiration from Large Language Models, we introduce the Incremental TNP ($\texttt{incTNP}$).
sentences.zh: 借鉴大语言模型的灵感，我们引入了增量式TNP（$\texttt{incTNP}$）。

sentences.en: By leveraging causal masking, Key-Value (KV) caching, and a data-efficient autoregressive training strategy, $\texttt{incTNP}$ matches the predictive performance of standard TNPs while reducing the computational cost of updates from quadratic to linear time complexity.
sentences.zh: 通过利用因果掩蔽、键值（KV）缓存和数据高效的自回归训练策略，$\texttt{incTNP}$ 在匹配标准TNP预测性能的同时，将更新计算成本从二次降至线性时间复杂度。

sentences.en: We empirically evaluate our model on a range of synthetic and real-world tasks, including tabular regression and temperature prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们在一系列合成和现实任务（包括表格回归和温度预测）上实证评估了我们的模型。

sentences.en: Our results show that, surprisingly, $\texttt{incTNP}$ delivers performance comparable to—or better than—non-causal TNPs while unlocking orders-of-magnitude speedups for sequential inference.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，令人惊讶的是，$\texttt{incTNP}$ 提供了与非因果TNP相当甚至更好的性能，同时为序列推断解锁了数量级的加速。

sentences.en: Finally, we assess the consistency of the model's updates---by adapting a metric of "implicit Bayesianness", we show that under a one-at-a-time streaming protocol, $\texttt{incTNP}$ retains a prediction rule as implicitly Bayesian as standard non-causal TNPs, demonstrating that $\texttt{incTNP}$ achieves the computational benefits of causal masking without sacrificing the consistency required for streaming inference.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们评估模型更新的一致性——通过适配一个“隐式Bayesian性”的度量，我们表明在逐条流式协议下，$\texttt{incTNP}$ 保持一个与标准非因果TNP同样隐式Bayesian的预测规则，证明 $\texttt{incTNP}$ 在牺牲流式推断所需一致性的前提下实现了因果掩蔽的计算收益。

title_en: Independent Component Discovery in Temporal Count Data
title_zh: 时序计数数据中的独立成分发现

sentences.en: Advances in data collection are producing growing volumes of temporal count observations, making adapted modeling increasingly necessary.
sentences.zh: 数据采集的进步正产生日益增长的时序计数观测，使得适配的建模越来越必要。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a generative framework for independent component analysis of temporal count data, combining regime-adaptive dynamics with Poisson log-normal emissions.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了一个用于时序计数数据独立成分分析的生成式框架，它将机制自适应动力学与Poisson对数正态发射相结合。

sentences.en: The model identifies disentangled components with regime-dependent contributions, enabling representation learning and perturbations analysis.
sentences.zh: 该模型识别出具有机制依赖贡献的解耦成分，从而实现表示学习和扰动分析。

sentences.en: Notably, we establish the identifiability of the model, supporting principled interpretation.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们确立了模型的可辨识性，支持有原则的解释。

sentences.en: To learn the parameters, we propose an efficient amortized variational inference procedure.
sentences.zh: 为学习参数，我们提出了一种高效的分摊变分推断过程。

sentences.en: Experiments on simulated data evaluate recovery of the mixing function and latent sources across diverse settings, while real-world applications to gut microbiome and climate datasets reveal co-variation patterns and regime shifts consistent with domain-specific knowledge.
sentences.zh: 在模拟数据上的实验评估了在不同设置下对混合函数和潜在源的恢复，而对肠道微生物组和气候数据集的现实世界应用则揭示了与领域特定知识一致的协变模式和机制转变。

title_en: INDEXGUARD: Index-only Backdoor Vetting for Secure Federated PEFT of Large Language Models
title_zh: INDEXGUARD：仅索引的后门审查用于大语言模型的安全联邦PEFT

sentences.en: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables customizing large language models on private data, yet it is vulnerable to backdoor poisoning—especially when privacy constraints prevent inspection of per-client real-valued updates.
sentences.zh: 联邦参数高效微调（PEFT）能够在私有数据上定制大语言模型，然而它易受后门投毒攻击——尤其是当隐私约束阻止检查每个客户端的实值更新时。

sentences.en: We exploit the intuition that poisoning leaves a similar backdoor imprint in which adapter coordinates become salient, so overlap in salient-index supports remains informative even without values.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这样的直觉：投毒会在适配器坐标变得显著的局部留下相似的后门印痕，因此显著索引支撑的重叠即使在没有数值的情况下也具有信息性。

sentences.en: We introduce IndexGuard, an unsupervised index-only vetting primitive in which clients send only Top-$K$ salient update indices and the server operates on the induced overlap geometry, clustering clients and filtering cohesion-outlier groups before aggregation.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了IndexGuard，一种无监督的仅索引审查原语，其中客户端仅发送Top-$K$显著更新索引，服务器在由此产生的重叠几何上操作，在聚合前对客户端进行聚类并过滤掉内聚异常组。

sentences.en: We analyze support stability under bounded rescaling and separability under shared-trigger poisoning under non-IID drift.
sentences.zh: 我们分析了在有界重缩放下的支撑稳定性，以及在非IID漂移下共享触发器投毒的可分离性。

sentences.en: Across attacks, backbones, and PEFT variants, IndexGuard provides end-to-end mitigation, preserving clean accuracy while achieving performance comparable to centralized methods.
sentences.zh: 跨多种攻击、骨干和PEFT变体，IndexGuard提供了端到端的缓解，在保持干净准确率的同时实现了与集中式方法相当的性能。

title_en: IndexMem: Learned KV-Cache Eviction with Latent Memory for Long-Context LLM Inference
title_zh: IndexMem：带潜在记忆的学习式KV缓存驱逐用于长上下文LLM推断

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to operate over long contexts, yet standard softmax attention incurs a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, quickly becoming the bottleneck for long context inference.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）日益被期望在长上下文上工作，然而标准softmax注意力产生的KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，迅速成为长上下文推断的瓶颈。

sentences.en: A practical remedy is to evict less important KV entries; however, existing eviction policies are largely heuristic and struggle to capture the rich, input-dependent distribution of token importance.
sentences.zh: 一个实用的补救措施是驱逐较不重要的KV条目；然而，现有驱逐策略在很大程度上是启发式的，难以捕获词元重要性的丰富、输入依赖的分布。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a **learnable indexer** that predicts KV importance, enabling more accurate retention of critical tokens.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了一个**可学习索引器**，它预测KV重要性，从而能够更精确地保留关键词元。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, naively evicting tokens permanently discards their information, leading to irreversible forgetting and degraded retrieval over long ranges.
sentences.zh: 同时，天真地驱逐词元会永久丢弃其信息，导致不可逆的遗忘和长距离检索性能退化。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a lightweight **latent memory module** that compresses evicted tokens into a compact, online-updated state and provides residual readouts to compensate for the attention contributions lost through KV eviction.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个轻量级**潜在记忆模块**，它将被驱逐的词元压缩为紧凑的、在线更新的状态，并提供残差读出以补偿因KV驱逐而损失的注意力贡献。

sentences.en: Collectively, our method enables accurate long-context inference under a bounded KV budget, delivering consistent improvements on RULER (4K/16K) across Qwen, Mistral, and Llama models (up to 25 points under aggressive eviction), markedly more stable Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval, and superior LongBench scores and compression curves compared to existing eviction policies.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我们的方法使有界KV预算下的精确长上下文推断成为可能，在RULER（4K/16K）上跨Qwen、Mistral和Llama模型提供一致的改进（在激进驱逐下最多25分），实现了显著更稳定的Needle-in-a-Haystack检索，并相较现有驱逐策略获得了更优的LongBench分数和压缩曲线。

title_en: Inducing Overthink: Hierarchical Genetic Algorithm-based DoS Attack on Black-Box Large Language Reasoning Models
title_zh: 诱导过度思考：基于层级遗传算法的黑盒大语言推理模型DoS攻击

sentences.en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are increasingly integrated into systems requiring reliable multi-step inference, yet this growing dependence exposes new vulnerabilities related to computational availability.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRMs）日益被集成到需要可靠多步推断的系统中，然而这种日益增长的依赖暴露了与计算可用性相关的新漏洞。

sentences.en: In particular, LRMs exhibit a tendency to “overthink’’—producing excessively long and redundant reasoning traces—when confronted with incomplete or logically inconsistent inputs.
sentences.zh: 特别是，当面对不完整或逻辑不一致的输入时，LRM表现出“过度思考”的倾向——产生过长且冗余的推理轨迹。

sentences.en: This behavior significantly increases inference latency and energy consumption, forming a potential vector for denial-of-service (DoS) style resource exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 这种行为显著增加了推断延迟和能耗，构成了拒绝服务（DoS）式资源耗尽的潜在载体。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate this attack surface and propose an automated black-box framework that induces overthinking in LRMs by systematically perturbing the logical structure of input problems.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了这一攻击面，并提出一个自动化黑盒框架，它通过系统性地扰动输入问题的逻辑结构来诱导LRM的过度思考。

sentences.en: Our method employs a hierarchical genetic algorithm (HGA) operating on structured problem decompositions, and optimizes a composite fitness function designed to maximize both response length and reflective overthinking markers.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法采用在结构化问题分解上运行的层级遗传算法（HGA），并优化一个复合适应度函数，旨在同时最大化响应长度和反思性过度思考标记。

sentences.en: Across four state-of-the-art reasoning models, the proposed method substantially amplifies output length, achieving up to a 26.1× increase on the MATH benchmark and consistently outperforming benign and manually crafted missing-premise baselines.
sentences.zh: 在四个最先进的推理模型上，所提方法大幅放大了输出长度，在MATH基准上实现高达26.1×的增加，并持续优于良性以及手工制作的缺失前提基线。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate strong transferability, showing that adversarial inputs evolved using a small proxy model retain high effectiveness against large commercial LRMs.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明了强迁移性，表明使用小型代理模型演化出的对抗输入对大型商业LRM仍保持高有效性。

sentences.en: These findings highlight overthinking as a shared and exploitable vulnerability in modern reasoning systems, underscoring the need for more robust defenses.
sentences.zh: 这些发现凸显了过度思考是现代推理系统中一个共同的、可利用的漏洞，强调了需要更鲁棒的防御。

title_en: Induction Heads Interpolate N-Grams
title_zh: 归纳头平滑插值N-gram

sentences.en: Induction heads are attention circuits believed to underlie in-context learning in transformers, yet a precise characterization of the estimators they implement remains elusive.
sentences.zh: 归纳头（induction heads）是据信构成transformer中上下文学习基础的注意力回路，然而对它们所实现的估计器的精确刻画仍难以捉摸。

sentences.en: We study transformers trained on order-$k$ Markov chains and identify two complementary smoothing mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在 $k$ 阶Markov链上训练的transformer，并识别出两种互补的平滑机制。

sentences.en: First, at finite attention-weight scale, the circuit implements a soft context-matching estimator: it aggregates contributions from exact and partial context matches, weighted exponentially by their overlap, and induces a data-dependent interpolation across context orders analogous to Jelinek--Mercer smoothing.
sentences.zh: 首先，在有限注意力权重尺度下，该回路实现一种软上下文匹配估计器：它聚合来自精确与部分上下文匹配的贡献，按重叠度呈指数加权，并引发一种跨上下文阶数的数据依赖插值，类似于Jelinek--Mercer平滑。

sentences.en: Second, a beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token induces additive pseudo-counts, recovering Dirichlet-style smoothing.
sentences.zh: 其次，一个序列开始（BOS）词元引入加性伪计数，恢复了Dirichlet式平滑。

sentences.en: We construct a disentangled transformer implementing both mechanisms and show that trained transformers recover the predicted attention patterns.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了一个解耦的transformer来实现这两种机制，并表明训练过的transformer能恢复预测的注意力模式。

sentences.en: Across settings where pseudo-count smoothing is optimal or lower-order contexts provide structured evidence, trained transformers match or outperform classical count-based baselines.
sentences.zh: 在伪计数平滑最优或低阶上下文提供结构化证据的设置中，训练过的transformer匹配或超越了经典的基于计数的基线。

sentences.en: Our results bridge mechanistic interpretability of induction heads with classical statistical smoothing, revealing that transformers learn to regularize in-context estimation rather than simply count.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果将归纳头的机制可解释性与经典统计平滑联系起来，揭示transformer学习的是正则化上下文估计，而非简单地计数。

title_en: Induction Meets Biology: Mechanisms of Repeat Detection in Protein Language Models
title_zh: 归纳遇上生物学：蛋白质语言模型中的重复检测机制

sentences.en: Protein sequences are abundant in repeating segments, both as exact copies and as approximate segments with mutations.
sentences.zh: 蛋白质序列中富含重复片段，既有精确副本，也有带突变的近似片段。

sentences.en: These repeats are important for protein structure and function, motivating decades of algorithmic work on repeat identification.
sentences.zh: 这些重复对蛋白质结构和功能很重要，促使了数十年来关于重复识别的算法研究。

sentences.en: Recent work has shown that protein language models (PLMs) identify repeats, by examining their behavior in masked-token prediction.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，蛋白质语言模型（PLM）通过掩码词元预测中的行为能够识别重复。

sentences.en: To elucidate their internal mechanisms, we investigate how PLMs detect both exact and approximate repeats.
sentences.zh: 为阐明其内部机制，我们研究了PLM如何检测精确和近似的重复。

sentences.en: We find that the mechanism for approximate repeats functionally subsumes that of exact repeats.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，近似重复的检测机制在功能上涵盖了精确重复的机制。

sentences.en: We then characterize this mechanism, revealing two main stages: PLMs first build feature representations using both general positional attention heads and biologically specialized components, such as neurons that encode amino-acid similarity.
sentences.zh: 我们随后刻画了这一机制，揭示出两个主要阶段：PLM首先使用通用的位置注意力头和生物学特化的组件（如编码氨基酸相似性的神经元）构建特征表示。

sentences.en: Then, induction heads attend to aligned tokens across repeated segments, promoting the correct answer.
sentences.zh: 然后，归纳头跨重复段关注对齐的词元，促进正确答案的产生。

sentences.en: Our results reveal how PLMs solve this biological task by combining language-based pattern matching with specialized biological knowledge, thereby establishing a basis for studying more complex evolutionary processes in PLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果揭示了PLM通过将基于语言的模式匹配与特化的生物学知识相结合来解决这一生物学任务，从而为在PLM中研究更复杂的进化过程建立了基础。

title_en: INDUCTION: Finite-Structure Concept Synthesis in First-Order Logic
title_zh: INDUCTION：一阶逻辑中的有限结构概念合成

sentences.en: bstract: Large language and reasoning models can be prompted to generate well-formed first-order formulas, but we still lack evaluations of their ability to produce correct, compact explanations under fully specified, mechanically checkable semantics.
sentences.zh: 摘要：大型语言与推理模型可以被提示生成格式良好的一阶公式，但我们仍然缺乏对其在完全指定、机制上可检查的语义下生成正确、紧凑解释的能力的评估。

sentences.en: We study finite-structure concept synthesis: given several small finite relational worlds that are labeled extensionally with a unary target predicate $T(x)$, the learner must output a single first-order formula $\varphi(x)$ that recovers (explains) $T$ uniformly across worlds.
sentences.zh: 我们研究有限结构概念合成：给定若干以一元目标谓词 $T(x)$ 外延式标注的小型有限关系世界，学习器必须输出一个单一的一阶公式 $\varphi(x)$，它能跨世界一致地恢复（解释）$T$。

sentences.en: Because the domains are finite, correctness is solver-verifiable via exact model checking and SMT.
sentences.zh: 由于域是有限的，正确性可以通过精确模型检验和SMT由求解器验证。

sentences.en: We introduce INDUCTION, a benchmark suite that (to our knowledge) provides the first challenging, end-to-end evaluation of first-order definition synthesis from extensional relational evidence in a fully abstract interface.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了INDUCTION，一个基准套件，据我们所知，它提供了在完全抽象接口中从外延关系证据进行一阶定义合成的首个具有挑战性的端到端评估。

sentences.en: INDUCTION includes three tightly related regimes---FullObs (full observation), CI (contrastive Yes/No worlds), and EC (partial observation under existential completion)---and reports gold-relative, budgeted metrics that penalize formula bloat.
sentences.zh: INDUCTION包含三个紧密相关的机制——FullObs（完全观测）、CI（对比式是/否世界）和EC（存在性完成下的部分观测）——并报告了黄金标准的、有预算的、惩罚公式臃肿的指标。

sentences.en: Across tasks we observe sharp difficulty gradients and persistent hard structural families; moreover, held-out world evaluation shows that among training-correct solutions, low-bloat formulas generalize far better than highly bloated ones, motivating bloat-aware scoring as a first-class metric for symbolic induction.
sentences.zh: 跨任务我们观察到陡峭的难度梯度和持续性的困难结构族；此外，保留世界的评估表明，在训练正确的解中，低臃肿公式的泛化远好于高度臃肿的公式，这促使将臃肿感知评分作为符号归纳的一等指标。

title_en: InertialAR: Autoregressive 3D Molecule Generation with Inertial Frames
title_zh: InertialAR：带惯性框架的自回归3D分子生成

sentences.en: Transformer-based autoregressive models have emerged as a unifying paradigm across modalities such as text and images, but their extension to 3D molecule generation remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 基于Transformer的自回归模型已涌现为跨文本和图像等多种模态的统一范式，但它们向3D分子生成的扩展仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: The gap stems from two fundamental challenges: (1) how to tokenize molecules into a canonical 1D sequence of tokens that is invariant to both SE(3) transformations and atom index permutations, and (2) how to design an architecture capable of modeling hybrid atom-based tokens that couple discrete atom types with continuous 3D coordinates.
sentences.zh: 这一差距源于两个根本挑战：（1）如何将分子词元化为一个对SE(3)变换和原子索引置换都不变的规范1D词元序列；（2）如何设计一个能够建模耦合离散原子类型与连续3D坐标的混合原子词元的架构。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce InertialAR.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们引入了InertialAR。

sentences.en: It first performs generation-oriented canonical tokenization by aligning each molecule to a canonical inertial frame and reordering atoms, thereby converting arbitrary 3D structures into a unique, SE(3)- and permutation-invariant sequence of tokens for autoregressive generation.
sentences.zh: 它首先通过将每个分子对齐到规范惯性框架并重排原子，执行面向生成的规范词元化，从而将任意3D结构转换为一个唯一的、SE(3)和置换不变的词元序列，用于自回归生成。

sentences.en: Built upon this canonical tokenization, we propose geometric positional encoding (GeoPE), which endows Transformer attention with 3D geometric awareness.
sentences.zh: 在此规范词元化基础上，我们提出了几何位置编码（GeoPE），它为Transformer注意力赋予3D几何感知。

sentences.en: Finally, InertialAR utilizes a hierarchical autoregressive paradigm to decode the next atom, consecutively predicting the atom type and 3D coordinates via Diffusion Loss.
sentences.zh: 最后，InertialAR利用层级自回归范式解码下一个原子，通过扩散损失连续预测原子类型和3D坐标。

sentences.en: Experimentally, InertialAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on 8 of the 10 evaluation metrics for unconditional generation across QM9, GEOM-Drugs, and B3LYP.
sentences.zh: 实验上，在QM9、GEOM-Drugs和B3LYP上，InertialAR在无条件生成的10个评估指标中的8个上达到了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Moreover, it significantly outperforms baselines in controllable generation for targeted chemical functionality, attaining state-of-the-art results across all 5 metrics.
sentences.zh: 此外，在面向定向化学功能的可控生成中，它显著优于基线，在所有5个指标上取得了最先进的结果。

sentences.en: Code is available at github.com/HaoruiLi46/InertialAR.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 github.com/HaoruiLi46/InertialAR 获取。

title_en: INFER: Learning Implicit Neural Frequency Response Fields for Confined Acoustic Environments
title_zh: INFER：为受限声学环境学习隐式神经频率响应场

sentences.en: Neural acoustic fields often model time-domain impulse responses, which struggle to capture the frequency-selective wave behaviors that dominate confined, resonant environments.
sentences.zh: 神经声学场通常对时域脉冲响应建模，这难以捕获主导受限、混响环境中的频率选择性波行为。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose INFER (Implicit Neural Frequency Response fields), a framework that directly learns continuous, complex-valued frequency response fields.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了INFER（隐式神经频率响应场），一个直接学习连续、复值频率响应场的框架。

sentences.en: Unlike prior time-domain methods, our frequency-first approach enables three key innovations: (1) end-to-end learning of frequency-specific attenuation and phase delay in 3D space; (2) a physics-based Kramers–Kronig consistency constraint that causally regularizes attenuation and phase delay; and (3) perceptual and hardware-aware spectral supervision that prioritizes critical auditory bands.
sentences.zh: 与先前的时域方法不同，我们的频率优先方法实现了三个关键创新：（1）在3D空间中端到端学习频率特定的衰减和相位延迟；（2）一个基于物理的Kramers–Kronig一致性约束，它因果地正则化衰减和相位延迟；以及（3）优先考虑关键听觉频带的感知和硬件感知频谱监督。

sentences.en: We evaluate INFER across diverse settings, ranging from standard room-scale benchmarks (MeshRIR, RAF) to challenging, highly reverberant environments like real car cabins.
sentences.zh: 我们在多样设置中评估INFER，范围从标准房间尺度基准（MeshRIR、RAF）到如真实汽车座舱等具有挑战性的高度回声环境。

sentences.en: Our approach significantly outperforms time- and hybrid-domain baselines, reducing average magnitude and phase reconstruction errors by over 39\% and 51\%, respectively, demonstrating state-of-the-art accuracy in modeling complex acoustic spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法显著优于时域和混合域基线，将平均幅度和相位重建误差分别降低超过39\%和51\%，展示了在复杂声学空间建模中的最先进准确率。

title_en: Inference from Quantized Data via Normal Variance-Mean Mixtures
title_zh: 通过正态方差-均值混合从量化数据推断

sentences.en: Inference from quantized data has received significant attention in recent years due to its broad applications in machine learning and signal processing.
sentences.zh: 由于在机器学习和信号处理中的广泛应用，从量化数据进行的推断在近年受到显著关注。

sentences.en: Existing likelihood-based approaches are often restricted to Gaussian assumptions or low-bit quantization settings, limiting modeling flexibility and robustness under complex data distributions.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于似然的方法往往局限于高斯假设或低位量化设置，限制了在复杂数据分布下的建模灵活性和鲁棒性。

sentences.en: In this work, we study inference from quantized observations under the general normal variance-mean mixture (NVMM) framework, which encompasses distributions including Gaussian, $t$, generalized hyperbolic skew-$t$, and generalized hyperbolic distributions.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们在一般的正态方差-均值混合（NVMM）框架下研究从量化观测进行的推断，该框架涵盖包括Gaussian、$t$、广义双曲偏-$t$和广义双曲分布在内的分布。

sentences.en: Optimization under the NVMM framework is challenging because the underlying likelihood function involves multidimensional integrals that are difficult to evaluate due to multidimensional quantization and latent mixture variables.
sentences.zh: NVMM框架下的优化具有挑战性，因为潜在的似然函数涉及多维积分，由于多维量化和潜在混合变量而难以评估。

sentences.en: To address this difficulty, we propose an expectation conditional maximization (ECM) algorithm with latent-variable augmentations for both quantization and mixture modeling.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一困难，我们提出了一个带有潜变量增强的期望条件最大化（ECM）算法，同时用于量化和混合建模。

sentences.en: By leveraging the conditional Gaussian structure of the NVMM family, the proposed method admits closed-form updates for all model parameters at each iteration, leading to an efficient and tractable optimization procedure.
sentences.zh: 通过利用NVMM族的条件高斯结构，所提方法在每次迭代中对所有模型参数都允许闭式更新，导致一个高效且可处理的优化过程。

sentences.en: We further establish global linear convergence guarantees for the proposed ECM algorithm.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步为所提ECM算法确立了全局线性收敛保证。

sentences.en: Beyond basic parameter estimation, the proposed framework naturally extends to several structured learning and recovery tasks under the NVMM framework, including quantized regression, matrix completion, compressive sensing, and covariance estimation.
sentences.zh: 超越基本参数估计，所提框架自然扩展到NVMM框架下的若干结构化学习与恢复任务，包括量化回归、矩阵补全、压缩感知和协方差估计。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework across a variety of quantized inference problems.
sentences.zh: 数值实验证明了所提框架在各类量化推断问题上的有效性和鲁棒性。

title_en: Inference of Online Newton Methods with Nesterov's Accelerated Sketching
title_zh: 带Nesterov加速草图的在线Newton方法的推断

sentences.en: Reliable decision-making with streaming data requires principled uncertainty quantification of online methods.
sentences.zh: 使用流式数据的可靠决策需要对在线方法进行有原则的不确定性量化。

sentences.en: While first-order methods enable efficient iterate updates, their inference procedures still require updating proper (covariance) matrices, incurring $O(d^2)$ time and memory complexity, and are sensitive to ill-conditioning and noise heterogeneity of the problem.
sentences.zh: 虽然一阶方法能够实现高效的迭代更新，但它们的推断过程仍需要更新适当的（协）方差矩阵，产生 $O(d^2)$ 的时间和内存复杂度，并且对问题的病态性和噪声异质性敏感。

sentences.en: This costly inference task offers an opportunity for more robust second-order methods, which are, however, bottlenecked by solving Newton systems with $O(d^3)$ complexity.
sentences.zh: 这一昂贵的推断任务为更鲁棒的二阶方法提供了机会，然而它们却受制于求解具有 $O(d^3)$ 复杂度的Newton系统这一瓶颈。

sentences.en: In this paper, we address this gap by studying an online Newton method with Hessian averaging, where the Newton direction at each step is approximately computed using a *sketch-and-project solver with Nesterov's acceleration*, matching $O(d^2)$ complexity of first-order methods.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过研究一种带Hessian平均的在线Newton方法来解决这一差距，其中每一步的Newton方向使用*带Nesterov加速的草图和投影求解器*近似计算，从而匹配一阶方法的 $O(d^2)$ 复杂度。

sentences.en: For the proposed method, we quantify its uncertainty arising from both random data and randomized computation.
sentences.zh: 对于所提方法，我们量化了由随机数据和随机计算引发的不确定性。

sentences.en: Under standard smoothness and moment conditions, we establish global almost-sure convergence, prove asymptotic normality of the last iterate with a limiting covariance characterized by a Lyapunov equation, and develop a fully online covariance estimator with non-asymptotic convergence guarantees.
sentences.zh: 在标准光滑性和矩条件下，我们确立了全局几乎必然收敛，证明了末次迭代的渐近正态性（其极限协方差由Lyapunov方程刻画），并开发了一个具有非渐近收敛保证的完全在线协方差估计器。

sentences.en: We also connect the resulting uncertainty quantification to that of exact and sketched Newton methods without Nesterov's acceleration.
sentences.zh: 我们还将所得的不确定性量化与不带Nesterov加速的精确和草图Newton方法联系起来。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on regression models demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method for online inference.
sentences.zh: 在回归模型上的大量实验证明了所提方法在在线推断中的优越性。

title_en: Inference Time Concept Removal Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_zh: 文本到图像扩散模型的推断时概念移除引导

sentences.en: Text-to-image diffusion models remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that elicit disallowed content, motivating reliable inference-time controls.
sentences.zh: 文本到图像扩散模型仍然容易受到诱导违禁内容的对抗性提示的攻击，这促使了对可靠推断时控制的需求。

sentences.en: A popular approach is negative guidance, which subtracts a negative-prompt direction with a fixed weight.
sentences.zh: 一种流行的方法是负引导，它用一个固定权重减去负提示方向。

sentences.en: However, it often forces a safety–fidelity trade-off, causing artifacts or prompt drift when over-applied and failing under attacks when under-applied.
sentences.zh: 然而，它往往迫使在安全性与保真度之间进行权衡：过度应用时造成伪影或提示漂移，应用不足时在攻击下失效。

sentences.en: Recent dynamic variants reweight guidance using posterior-odds signals, which can be brittle for open-vocabulary compositional prompts, while lightweight similarity-based methods do not leverage the evolving image evidence along the denoising trajectory.
sentences.zh: 近期动态变体使用后验几率信号对引导重新加权，这对开放词汇的组合性提示可能很脆弱，而轻量的基于相似度的方法则没有利用沿去噪轨迹演化的图像证据。

sentences.en: We introduce Concept Removal Guidance (CRG), a training-free, plug-and-play method that estimates unwanted-concept presence at each diffusion step using only the noise predictions from the model, and then adaptively gates and calibrates negative guidance via a closed-form constrained update that enforces a target presence threshold while minimally perturbing the conditional trajectory.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了概念移除引导（CRG），一种免训练、即插即用的方法，它仅使用模型的噪声预测来估计每个扩散步的不希望概念存在度，然后通过一个封闭形式约束更新自适应地门控和校准负引导，该更新在最小程度扰动条件轨迹的同时强制执行目标存在阈值。

sentences.en: Across multiple red-teaming benchmarks, CRG significantly reduces attack success rates while improving benign fidelity, and additional suppression targets such as artist style and violence  without fine-tuning or external classifiers.
sentences.zh: 在多个红队基准上，CRG显著降低了攻击成功率，同时提升了良性保真度，并且无需微调或外部分类器即可支持诸如艺术家风格和暴力等额外的抑制目标。
